sg: Foutingô â yé ni a tônda ni na ngbonga 11:00 na ndô ti Whitehall lè na lè na légé ti lindagô ti a zo ti pulusu na ndô ti légé ti Dowing, dä ti kozô gbeon gbia.

sg: Na ngbonga 11:20, â pulusu a hounda na â zo ti foutingô â yé sô tô zi légé yamba na ti louti na mbagé ti légé teti ndia a kin ti tongana a zo a louti na ndô ti légé tongana ala yé ti hounda ndia ti ala.

en: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.
sg: Na yé â ngbonga 11:29, a zo ti foutingô yé ni a gué juska na Whitehall, ala hon na légé ti Trafalgar, na tèrè ti ndö ti kango yé, na tèrè ti Aldwych ti si na Kingsway na légé ti guéngo na Holborn na ndô ti bungbi ti poroso ti â Conservatifs, na ala ngbâ ti gbu kota mbéti ti ala na maboko na yâ ti dä ti hotel Grand Connaught.

sg: "Â mbéti ti Panama" a yéké parapluie teti ê kutu baléoko ti â mbéti ti ndia na ndô ti â buzé na Panama, â ndia ti Mosack Fonseca, sô a sigigi na yâ ti â mbéti sangö na ngü 2016.

sg: Â Mbéti ni afa sô â ndôkua ti batango nginza baléoko na osio a mü maboko na â klean ti ala sô a yéké na mosoro ti hondé a ngundangu mingi ti dollar ti Amerika ti kpé foutangô lapo na â mbéni â mbéti nga.

sg: Hsieh a tènè sô yé sô a fâ tènè na ndô ti Ma mingi a yeke sarango yé ti lo, mais gangu ti lo pèpè.

en: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

en: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.
sg: Wâ tango ndémbo ti lâ sô a yeke Alex Ovechkin ti kota gbata ti Washington.

sg: Lo sön benda na ngü 2 na lo mü maboko na ngoye ti pikango ndémbo ti bungbi ti Washington sô a wara ngü 5-3 lè na lè na bungbi ti Atlanta Trashers.

en: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

en: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

en: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.
sg: Lo wara makanda ti dä ota na dä sendagigi ti Virginie na 1950 na lo mu maboko mingi na yâ ndô kusala sô.

sg: Dä ti kanga ti Abu Ghraib na kodro ti Iraq a zia a zo dä mingi na ngoye ti riot.

sg: Dä ti kanga ni aga nzoni na péko ti sô a hinga tènè salango yé ti ngangu na tèrè ti â zo ti kanga na péko ti sô â turugu ti Amerika a tônda ti sala kusala kâ.

sg: Na ngoye so kutukutu sô a ke na dawäa ti Alonso a gué ti mü ngü ti dada na gbé ti kutukutu ti sédouti, lo hon hio ti sön benda.

en: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

sg: Gî na ngbonga 8:46, mbéni kota hush a tï na yâ ti gbata ni, sô a fa tâa gî kozô ngoye sô jet ni a tï na ni.

en: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.
sg: Kota wä a za na lè ti nduzu na bï juska ndapélélé.

sg: Â ngbâ ti lèkèrè â yongoro kota dä na ndö ti kusala sô, a yeke â dä ti ndôkua ti transport nga na ti Park ti da bè na katikâtï ni.

en: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.
sg: PBS Show ayeke na gbati a futa Emmy fani use, nga na mungo loro ti lo ayeke nduru ahon ti Sesame Street nga na Mister Rogers.

en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.
sg: A kapa ti fango limo ayeke gue gi na ndo kamba tene so ayeke na ya ti mbeni gbuku so ake nde, nga asa ya ni na lege ti a gba ti ambayi.

en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.
sg: A fango limo a fa nga ahunda ngo ye ti a gbuku so amolenge a lingbi ti gi tongana ala gue na da ti a gbuku.

en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."
sg: John Grant, ti ndokua ti WNED Buffalo (Ndokua ti Reading Rainbows) atene "Reading Rainbow a fa kete amolenge ndani ti dikongo ye,...ndoye ti dikongo ye - [fango ye] a mu ngangu na kete amolenge ti mu gbuku nga na ti diko ni."

en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.
sg: A mbeni so na popo ni John Grant, so legue ti wara ngo nguinza nga na gbiango ti senda guingo nda yé ti hinga na legue ti lekere gere kusala ti limo so a fa ingango ndo ala mu mamboko na kongo nda ti limo.

en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.
sg: Kota ngü nzapa ni, a pika mingi na 645 miles (kilometere 1040) na dô ti joa ti Cape Verde, na wa voungangô sangö a tènè sô ngü sô alingbi ti fouti â yé mingi na kodro sô kâ.

en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.
sg: Na ndëmbë sô, Fred a yeke na légé ti pupu na lo yeke hon hiô a sala 105 miles ouala (kilometere 165km/h) na yâ ti ngbonga ôko, na lo kè gué na mbagé ti Banga nga na dô.

en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.
sg: Fred a yeke mbéni kota pupu sô a yéké bouba â yé mingi na mbagé ti Bongo nga na Tô ti Atlantique a tônda na gango ti â limo ti Satellite, gî ota kota pupu lâ a sala 35°W na mbagé ti Tô.

en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.
sg: Na lango 24 ti nzè ti Mvuka ngü 1759, Arthur Guiness a su maboko ti lo na gbé ti mbéti ti salango Samba teti ngü 9000 na St James na gbata ti Diblin na kodro sésé ti Irlande.

en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.
sg: Ngü 250 na péko ni, ndôkua ti Guiness a kono na houngo ti nginza ti lo kwè a hon ngundangu ti Euro 10 na ndô ni na yâ ti ngü ôko.

en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.
sg: Jonny Reid, wa mungo maboko na zo ti gbotongô kutukutu ti bungbi ti A1GP na Nouvelle Zélande aga kozô zo ti gbotongô kutukutu hiô mingi na yâ ti dunia mobimba na kindangô zo ti gbotongô kutukutu Auckland Harbour Bridge, sô ngü ti lo a yeke 48 na kodro sésé ti Nouvelle Zélande.

en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.
sg: Pakara Reid a sara kwè ti kpé na kutukutu ti A1GP ti Nouvelle Zélande na houngo ti loro sô a sala kilometere 160 na yâ ti ngbonga ôko légé mbasambala na ndô ti pond.

en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.
sg: Â pulusu ti Nouvelle Zélande a gi ti inga houngo ti loro ti pakara Reid na légé masini ti ala gbâ, ti inga biani ngangu ti loro ti lo. Teti lo kutukutu Black Beauty a yeke na gbéni mingi, mais ôko pasa sô â pulusu ni a wara houngo ti loro ti lo, a yeke gî na ngoye sô pakara Reid a tara ti gué yeke na loro ti kilometere 160 na yâ ti ngbonga ôko.

en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.
sg: Na yâ ti â nzè 3 sô a hon, a zi a zo 80 na kanga na Central Booking Facility na a hounda na ala ti fouta mbéni nginza pèpè.

en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.
sg: Na nzè ti Ngube ti ngü sô, wa fango ngbanga Glynn a sigi na mbéni ndia sô a mü légé ti zi a zo sô kanga ala a hon ngbonga 24 na si adé â mü tènè ti yanga ti ala pèpè na péko ti sô a gbu ala.

en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.
sg: Kota komanda ti pulusu ni a yeke sara mbéni mbéti sô a fa houngo ti nginza sô zo ni alingbi ti fouta. Nga a su houngo ti nginza ni na yâ ti kambouta ti pulusu ti kodro na a bata teti â kusala.

en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.
sg: Mungo tènè yanga nga afa lango na ndia sô afa tènè ti lango ti fango ngbanga ti zo sô.

en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.
sg: Peter Costello, mbéni wa batangô nginza ti kodro sésé ti Australie, lo yeke na kota pasa ti ga andé kozo gbeon gbia na péko John Howard tongana mokonzi ti bungbi ti poroso Liberal Party teti mungo maboko ti lo na â ndôkua ti lèkèrèngo â kota lè ti ngombé na Australie.

en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.
sg: Pakara Costello a tènè tongana â lèkèrèngo â lè ti ngombé sô a tônda ti kono konomi ti Australie, alingbi Australie a sala si kusala ni ngbâ lakwè ti gué na dawäa.

en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.
sg: "Tongana a tônda ti kä ni, alingbi i wara ni. A yeke tongaso, fadé i kiri na péko mbéni pèpè." Pakara Costello a tènè.

en: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.
sg: Tongana ti sô Anda afa, "tènè ti kpalé ti sô a si na a zo a sala mbéto teti aga kota tènè sô, a yeke gi pulusu si a yeke na gündâ ni.

en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.
sg: Ndôkua ti pulusu a tènè Lo Piccolo a wara ngangu mungo maboko teti sô lo sala kusala na gbé ti Provenzano na Palermo, na nga salango kusala na lo a mou légé na lo ti sala bè ôko na lo na yâ ti kusala ti konongo â ndö ti kusala ti ala.

en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."
sg: Â mokonzi sô Provenzano si a bando na ndô ti ala na ngoye sô lo kaï bira na popo ti Riiva-driven na kodro ti lo ndali ti â tènè ti Mafia ti pakara Giovani Falcone na Paolo Borsellino na ngü 1992."

en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.
sg: Wahenda ti Ndôkua ti Apple, Steve Jobs a kanga singamè ti lo, na lo mä na nduzu na lo sigi na singamè ti iPhone na yâ ti bozo ti jeans ti lo.

en: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".
sg: Na yâ ti ngbonga 2 ti tènè, lo tènè tongaso "Lâ sô Apple a yeke gué to ti lèkèrè singamè na fini ni, fadé I yeke su fini mbéti ti mbaé lâ sô."

en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.
sg: Kodro sésé ti Bresil a yeke kota ahon kodro ti dunia mobimba sô dä nzapa ti Catholique ti â Romain, nga na dä nzapa ti Catholique ti â Romain a kanga légé na yéngo dä na sungo maboko na gbé ti mbéti sô a mü légé na â koli usè ti fâ séléka na popo ti ala.

en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.
sg: Congrès ti kodro ti Bresil a a pika patara na ndô tènè ti mungo légé na â koli usè ti fâ séléka na popo ti ala depuis ngü 10, nga â mara ti fango séléka sô a zo alingbi ti fani gî na gbata ti Rio Grande dé Sul.

en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.
sg: A yeke ngbéré mokonzi gbata ti São Paulo, Marta Suplicy sî a su mbéti ti ndia sô. Na péko ti sungo mbéti ti ndia ti fani usè ni, mbéti ni a yeke na ngoye sô na maboko ti Roberto Jefferson.

en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.
sg: A zo ti fango ngonzo ti bé ti ala a yé ti wara mungo maboko ti a zo kutu 1.2 ti su maboko ti ala na gbé ti mbéti sô a yéké gué ti fa na Congrès na nzè ti Nabändurü.

en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.
sg: Na péko ti sô agbâ ti â sewâ a yeke gi ti wara mungo maboko ti govroma ti kanga légé na tombango ala, a lèkèrè mbéni bungbingo tèrè na lango 20 ti nzè ti Mbango na Ndôkua ti ndia ti East Bay Community ndali ti â zo so a händä ala teti dä.

en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.
sg: Na ngoye sô a zo a tônda ti tènè péko ti â yé sô a sï na ala, agbâ ti â sewâ abâ sô Carolyn Wilson ti OHA a händä ala na lo rö nginza na maboko ti ala, si lo kpé yâ ti gbata ni.

en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.
sg: A zo sô a händä ala, na si ala yeke na yâ ti Lockwood Gardens a ma na bè so â mbéni â sewâ 40 ouala a hon ndo ni angbâ ti bâ pasi na kpalé ti tombango ala, â tônda ni na ngoye sô ala inga sô â pulusu ti OHA angbâ ti asa yâ ti dä ti a zo na Oakland na alingbi ti gbu ala teti händängö-ndo na ndo tènè ti dä ti lango.

en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.
sg: Bungbi ti pikango mozoko a kin ti pika mozoko na Londo ti Maui's War Memorial, sô a lèkèrè ni ti tongana a zo 9,000 lâ a gué dä, na ala gbu gèrè ti a zo sô aga ti bä ala.

en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.
sg: Ndôkua ti salango kusala ti bungbi ti pikango mozoko so, HK Management Inc., afa mbrimbri ndâ ti kingô ti pika mozoko sô na lango 20 ti nzè ti Mvuka pèpè, mais la bï tènè ti na ndô ti â kpalé ti â gbakuru ti kusala ti ala, lango ôko na péko ni.

en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.
sg: Kota wäfango ngbanga ti kodro sésé ti Grèce, pakara Sakis Kechagioglou na George Nikolakopoulos a sara kanga na dä ti kanga ti Korydallus, teti sô a bï tènè na ndô ti ala teti goro.

en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.
sg: Na péko ti yé sô, mbéni kota tènè a londo na yâ ti kodro ti Grèce mobimba teti â ngbéré â sioni yé kwè sô â wâ fângö ngbanga a sara na yâ ti â ngü sô a hon.

en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.
sg: Kété yénga na péko ni, na péko ti sô si wangosinga Makis Triantafylopoulos a sara tènè ti sangö na yâ ti kapa sô a iri ni "Zoungla" na ndô kua singalè ti Alpha TV, â watokua ti badalezo nga na wäfango ngbanga Petros Mantouvalos a kin kusala ti ala teti a bï tènè ti pètèngô goro na ndô â mbä ti ala.

en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

sg: Aza akota kutukutu na lêgë ti kanga lêgë ni na hunda mungo maboko ti azo ti lapolusu 80 ti fa lêgë na azo ti kpengo na kutukutu.

sg: Kota zo ti bungbi ti bê africa na ti konomi nga na ti lekengo aye soi ri ti lo ayke Albert Muchanga a tene so ködörö ti benin kue aye ti li dâ.

sg: kota zo ni a tene : “ade e mä terê na ndo ti andia nga na a ngere ni ape, mê e peut ti mu ye na mba ni na kozo lango 1 ti nze ti Juillet ti ngu 2020.

en: The station maintained its attitude, despite the loss of a gyroscope earlier in the space station mission, until the end of the spacewalk.
sg: Ndokua ni angba na nduzu na ndo ti lo, atâa so ala girisa mbeni masini ti kua ti ala ni na ngoi so ala yeke na lè ti nduzu ngbii ala hunzi kua ni.

en: Chiao and Sharipov reported being a safe distance from the attitude adjustment thrusters.
sg: Chiao na Sharipov a tene so ala duti yongoro na ye ti tokuango masini ni lê ti nduzu.

sg: Azo ti bango ndo na ndô ti aye ni so ayeke arusse apete buton ni na awara ndo so lapara ni ayeke da na nduzu.

en: The case was prosecuted in Virginia because it is the home to the leading internet service provider AOL, the company who instigated the charges.
sg: A gue na tene ni na Virginie, a yeke kâ la zo ti tokuango aye na ndo ti ngbanda tere ti AOL, ndokua so ayeke na gunda ti atene so.

en: This is the first time a conviction has been gained using the legislation enacted in 2003 to curb bulk e-mail, aka spam, from unsolicited distribution into users mailboxes.
sg: A yeke kozo ti tene a dé ngbanga na ndo ti mbeni zo na sarango ye alingbi na ndia so asigi na ngu 2003 ti kanga lêgë na atënë so azo ayeke tene na ndo ti ngbanda tere, na atënë so azo awara ni nan do ti batango na ambeti ti tokua.

en: 21-year-old Jesus joined Manchester City last year in January 2017 from Brazilian club Palmeiras for a reported fee of £27 million.
sg: Jesus so ayeke na ngu 21, a londo na bungbi ti dembo ti gêrë ti brézil na palmeiras lo gue na bungbi ti dembo ti gêrë ti manchester City na ngu so ahon na nze ti nyenye ti ngu 2017 ndali ti nginza so wungo ni asi kutu 27 livre sterling.

sg: Ti londo na ngoi ni so ti ga na ni, zo ti brézil so a pika adembo nay a ti amandako nde so wungo ni asi 53 nga lo wara yengui ngbanda fani 24.

en: Dr. Lee also expressed his concern about reports that children in Turkey have now become infected with the A(H5N1) avian influenza virus without becoming ill.
sg: Wanganga Lee amâ so awara na turquie a môlengêe so ayeke na kobela ti grippe aviaire(H5N1) me so têrê ti ala asô ape.

en: Some studies suggest that the disease must become less lethal before it can cause a global epidemic, he noted.
sg: Ambeni mandango ye afa so na ngoi so na ngoi so kobela ni ayeke fâ ande azo mingi ape la lo yeke mû ndo ti sêse ande.

en: There is concern that patients may continue to infect more people by going through their daily routines if the flu symptoms remain mild.
sg: E yeke sara mbeto ti tene azo so ayeke na kobela ni me so têrê ti ala asô ape kangbi kobela ni.

en: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.
sg: Wa yanga ti Fondation Komen so iri ti lo ayeke Leslie Aun a tene so.

en: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.
sg: Poroso ti Komen la aza na gigi Planned parenthood ndali ti mbeni bembengo ndo so Cliff Sterns asara na ndo li lêgë so Planned parenthood ayeke sara ka na kua na nguinza ti lo.

en: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.
sg: Sterns aye ti hinga si Planned parenthood amu nginza ti tene a tuku na angö na mungo maboko ti kota zo ti ndokua ti bango ndo na ndô ti aye na ti bembengo ndo, so ayeke na gbe ti bungbi so aba ndo na ndô ti aye so andu tene ti energie na ti dengo buze.

en: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.
sg: Ngbêne mokonzi gbata ti Massachusetts so iri ti lo ayeke Mitt Rommey a sö benda na kozo sorongo gbia ti ködörö ti mbâgë ti arépublicain ti Floride, tongana amu azo ngbangbo azo ti lo asi 46.

en: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.
sg: Ngbêne Kota zo ti américa so iri ti lo ayeke Newt Gingrich aga ti lo na use ndo, tongana amu azo 32 la amu peko ti lo.

en: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.
sg: Gbata ti Floride asô benda na lo za azo ti lo bale-okou na Romney ti sara kua kà, na ye so asara si gbata ni aga na kozo ndo na ngoi ti zango zo nan do ti mbata ti gbia ti a républicain.

en: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.
sg: Azo ti lekere ngo gêrë ti tambula so atene so azo100,000 asi na aködörö ti zamani tongana Berlin, Cologne, Hambourg na Hanovre.

en: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.
sg: Na berlin a tourougou ti pouloussou a fa ndourou na sake omana na ngbangbo (6 500) hou ngo ti a zo so a fa ngonzo ti be ti ala na gigi.

en: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.
sg: A fa ngo ngonzo so a ba nga guigui na Paris, Sofia na Bulgarie, Vilnius ti Lituanie, Villeta na Malte, Tallinn na Estonie nga na Edimbourg na Glasgow na Ecosse.

en: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.
sg: Na Londres, a ga ndourou na a zo ngbangbo usé (200) so a fa ngonzo ti bè ti ala na tèrè ti a ndo kua koubou ti ala so a yéké wa bangondo na ndo ti ndia ti wa lèkèrèngo mbéni fini yé.

en: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.
sg: Na nze so a hon a fango ngozo ti be na mbegue ti Pologne na ngoy ni so kodoro ni a su mamboko na ACTA, so a mu legue na ngourougbia ti Pologne ti tene lo woko ya ti mango tere so fadefade so pepe.

en: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.
sg: Lettonie nga na Slovaquie ala use kue a gbanzi na peko legue ti li na ACTA.

en: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.
sg: Adokua so abâ ndo na ti aye so asara na a nyama (Animal Liberation na Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to animals na nduru tene RSPCA) a hunda ti tene aza a caméra ti bâ aye kue ayeke sara na ndo ti fango a nyama da ti ködörö ti Australie.

en: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.
sg: Kota zo ti ndokua ti RSPCA New South Wales so ri ti lo ayeke David O’Shannessy a tene na ABC so bango nzoni nga na guingo ti hinga aye so ayeke sara na a ndo ti fango anyama ayeke duti ndo so ala yeke baa mingi na kodoro sese ti Australie.

en: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."
sg: Tene ti zango a camera na ya ti labatoära asara si azo aga ti hinga so tznz ti nzoni ti a nyama la ayeke kota yé na lê ti ala.

en: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.
sg: Carte ti dedengo ti sese ti ndokua ti Hingango ye ti Sese ti Amerika a fa a dedengo ti Iceland pepe na yénga sô a hon.

en: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.
sg: Ndokua ti Sendo ti Islande atene gangon ti a dedengo ti sese ake si pepe na ndo ti sese ti Hekla na angbonga 48 so ake ga.

en: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.
sg: Sigingo ti dedengo ti sésé so alondo na légé ti gbian mbéni yé amu ndo na nzè ti Mbango lango 10 mbagé ti banga ti li ti volcan ti cadera.

en: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.
sg: Ambinda so avoko a fa ti tene mbeni sigingo ti volcan ayeke ga pepe na gbeni ti hoto.

en: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.
sg: Ambinda a sara li ti azo a ga kiri kiri la ni sendo ti fadeso a fa gangon ti a volcan.

en: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.
sg: Luno ayeke lani na gbâ ti carburant 120-160 na ya ti lo na ngoi so lo buba na oko ngoi ni ngangu pupu na kota mapo apusu ni na ya ti mbeni dou ti ngu.

en: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.
sg: Apupulenge la ague amû azo bale-oko na use ti ya ti mangbôkô. ni na zoo ko la awara kâ na hon ti lo.

sg: Kota mangbôkô. ti 100 mètre ayeke ga ti rô akungba so ayeke angrais na akota zo ti ködörö ni asara mbeto ti tene kota mangbôkô. ni a tuku mbene kota ye.

en: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.
sg: Bungbi ti azo ti senat a soro mbeni fini ndia so na ngu 2011.

en: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.
sg: Mbeni gbiango ye aga na ndembe so azo so aga na iri ti Senat azi use tënë ni so nay a ti ambela, na pekoni senat ayeda na mbeni tene so ague oko na ni na lango ti Bikoua-ôko.

en: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.
sg: Use tene ni so ake na koli na koli wala wali na wali ti mû tere so atî na ngu so apeut ti zi lêgë na ambeni mara ti mungo tere tongaso nay a ti angoi so ayeke ga.

en: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.
sg: Na peko ti aye so, ayeke sara kua na a fini mbela so asigi na ngu 2015 wala na ngu 2016 so angba ti sara na kua ti kiri ti bâ ya ti HJR-3 nzoni.

en: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.
sg: Aye so Vautier asara na ndo ti aye so kue awara na ya ni tene ti kengo tit è ye ti ngu 1973 nde na ye so lo bâ tongana ye so poroso angbanzi na zo.

en: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.
sg: A gbian ya ti ndia ti France. A sara ngu 15 awe so ama tënë ti angangu kusara ti lo na ngoi so lo sara use bira so amû ndo ti sêse kue.

en: He documented himself in a 1998 book.
sg: Lo diko mbeni buku ti ngu 1998.

en: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.
sg: Na ya ti angu 1960, lo kiri na ködörö ti algérie so a wara indépendance ti lo a ninga ape ti fa akusara so asara.

en: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.
sg: Zo ti judo ti ködörö ti Japon soi ri ti lo ayeke Hitoshi Saito so a awara medaille ti or fani use na ngia ti awanguru a kui na ngu 54.

en: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.
sg: A tene so kobela ti foie la afâ lo.

en: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.
sg: Lo kui na Osaka na lango Bikoua-ûse

en: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.
sg: Na ngoi so lo kui lo yeke Kota zo so abâ ndo na ndô ti comité ti tarango têrê ti azo ti judo ti japon, na ndo ni lo sö benda na lî ti azo na ngia ti awanguru.

en: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.
sg: Azo nduru na 100 la ague na matanga ni mbeni couple so asara ngu oko so ala sara mariage.

sg: A zo so ayeke na ndo aye ni atene so a leke ti sara fade mbeni matanga ti dango bê na alango so ayeke ga.

en: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.
sg: koli na wali so afa seleke na Texas a sara ngu oko awe na al aga lani na Buffalo ti sara matanga ni na akamarade nga azo ti sewa ti ala.

en: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.
sg: Koli ni ayeke na ngu 30, a dû lo na Buffalo na lo yeke na popo ti azo ossio so afa ala na ngombe, me wali ti lo awara kâ ape.

en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.
sg: Karno ayeke wa fango mbeti ti mundju anglais na azo ahinga lo mingui me na nda ni lo do ni lo zia, la fa lani mbeti ngbe ti Modern Education na King’s Glory na lo tene sol o fa mbeti na azo ahon 9000 na ya ti kua ti lo ti wafango mbeti.

en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.
sg: Ababa ti amôlengê afa so lo yeke tene a sioni yanga na ya ti ambeti ti lo nga lo yeke tene a zonga na ya ti ada mbeti.

en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.
sg: Modern Education a tene so la zia ambeti ti sambango na ye ti a bus na hondengo ni, na lo tene mvene sol o là lo yeke oko wafango mbeti ti mundju anglais.

en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.
sg: A tene sol o nzi buku ti mbeni zo, me aknga lo ndali ape.

en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'
sg: Mbeni ngbêne wa mandango mbeti a tene so ‘lo yeke sara kua na atënë so ayeke na lêgë ni ape, lo fa na ya ti ambeti tongana nyen ti wara tere na koli wala wali, na lo yeke nga tongana kamarade ti a wa mandango mbeti ni.

en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.
sg: Na ya ti angu ota so ahon atâa so na ködörö ti chine gui mbeni bungbi ti azo oko la ayeke mû decision na ndo ti aye kue ködörö a sara kue ti mû akungba ti lingbi na bezoin ti azo oko.

en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.
sg: A sara akozo gbiango ye na ndo tene ti konomi na ngoi so Deng Xiaoping la amû li ni.

en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.
sg: Ti londo na ngoi ni so ti ga ni konomi ti Chine a kono fani 90.

en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.
sg: Ti ngo so ahon ködörö ti chine a tokua gba ti akutukutu na ködörö wando ahon ködörö ti zamani na ti Etats-Unis so ayeke kozo ködörö.

en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.
sg: Na ya ti angu bale use so ayeke ga konomi ti Chine agué na li ni ti hon ti Etats-Unis.

en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.
sg: Kota pupu ti bubango ndo so iri ni ayeke Danielle so ayake ossio kota pupu ti ya ti ngu 2010 aga na mbâgë ti Océan Atlantique.

en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).
sg: Kota pupu, so ayeke na Floride na ayo na Miami a mètre 3,000 tongaso aga na a kete pupu ti 40mph(64kph) so aya mingui.

en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.
sg: Azo ti senda ye a tene so Dannielle ayeke ga ande na akota ngu nzapa na lango ti bikua ota.

en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.
sg: Ade kota pupu so asi nduru na sêse ape na ayeke ngangu ti ye so peut sara na ndo ti ködörö ti Etats-Unis wala na ndo ti a Caraïbe.

en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.
sg: Bobek so adû lo na Zagreb li ködörö ti croatie a pika dembo na Partizan Belgrade ye so asara si azo ahinga li mingui.

en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.
sg: Lo kiri na peko ti ala na ngu 1945 na lo ngba jusqu’à na ngu 1958.

en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.
sg: Na ngoi ti lo na equipe ni, lo gagné 403 na ya ti 468 so a fa.

en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.
sg: Mbeni zoo ko apika mara ti wungo ti adembo ti los o ape na ayengi ngbanda tongana ti lo ape.

en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.
sg: Na ngu 1995 a mu na loi ri ti kota zo ti pikango dembo na ya ti mbaï ti Partizan.

en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.
sg: A matanga ni ato nda ni na mbeni ngia bungbi soi ri ni ayeke Cirque du Soleil so azomingui ahinga ni.

en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.
sg: Azo so a mû peko lo ayeke azo pikango mozoko ti ndo sese ti Istanbul so ayeke aturuguna azo hengo bia tongana Fah Erkoç na Müslüm Gürses.

en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.
sg: Na pekoni a derviche tourneur a monté nan do scène ni.

en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.
sg: Wali hengo turquie Sezen Aksu ahe bia na Alessandro Sana italie nga na zo hengo bia grèce so iri lo ayeke Haris Alexiou.

en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".
sg: Ti hunzi na ni, azo dongo dodo so iri ti ala ayeke Fire of Anatolia a fa ngia ala soi ri niyeke « Troy ».

en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
sg: Peter Lenz zo kpengo na moto so ayeke na ngu 13 akui na peko mbeni ndao naIndianapolis Motor Speedway.

en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.
sg: Na ngoi so lo yeke tara tere na vélo lo na lo kpo mba lo Xavier Zayat.

en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.
sg: Azo tere piste ni a bâa lêgë lo kozo tene a gue na lo na hospital na pekoni lo kui.

en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.
sg: Zayat a wara ka na ya ndao ni so ape.

en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.
sg: Tongana a ndu tene nginza na ndo ti sêse kue, Zapatero a tene so “tene nginza ayeke mbeni mbâgë konomie so zo a lingbi bâ ni nzoni.”

en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."
sg: E wara mbeni kpale ti konomi a sara ngu oko, na a kiri a gué na li ni na ya ti anze use so ahon so, me aye a tonda ti kiri na lêgë ni awe.

en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.
sg: Na yenga so ahon, Naked News a tene loyeke andu tene ti fango peko ti aye so asi lo yeka za ande ambeni limo nota na ndo ni.

en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.
sg: Lo yeke fa peko ti aye so asi na yanga ti ködörö ti anglais, ti japonais. Ndokua ti gigi afa ti lo peko ti ye na yanga ti ködörö ti italie na ti corée, na télé a sara ti lo kua na ngbanda tere nga na fononon.

en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.
sg: Ye oko asi na mbi ape, me mbi bâa mbeni ti vundu na ngoi so azo ayeke fa avitre ti sigi.

en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.
sg: Azo a pika avitre ni na chaise me avitre ni afa ape.

en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.
sg: Franciszek so aso kua a tene so mbeni oko ti avitre a fa na nda ni na azo ni atonda ti sigi.

en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.
sg: Atongoro a tokua la na ndowa na lêgë so a atome ti hydrogène a bungbi tere ti mbeni ye so ane.

en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.
sg: Azo ti senda ndara a sara kua na mbeni ye so apeut ti sigui na energie tongaso.

en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.
sg: A yeke ngangu ti leke kpale so na asara ande angu mingui ti si na mara ti ye tongaso.

en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.
sg: Ngangu ti ngu ni asara si aiguille ti wen ni ayake hon nando ti ngu ni.

en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.
sg: A yeke bâ ngangu ti ndo ti ngu ni na ngoi so aye so na ya ti ngu ni agbu tere.

en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.
sg: Aye so ayeke na ya ti ngu asara si zo a peut ti bâ ndo na yâ ni, na soa a yeke duti na ndo ti ngu ni.

en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.
sg: Gbe ti poro ti kpengo na ndo ti glace ni ayeke na yanga use so dû ayeke nay â ni. A yanag ni use kue asara si lo kpe pendere nan do ti glace ni mêmê tongana lo dengi.

en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.
sg: Yanga ni angoro na mbâgë ti gbe ni, tongana lo dengi gbe ni kue adengi.

en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.
sg: A sara si zo ti kpengo na ndo ti glace ni a turunêe. Tongana a poro ti glace ni a gué na mbâgë ti koti, zo ti kpengo na ni kue a gué na mbâgë ti koti, Tongana a poro ti glace ni a gué na mbâgë ti gati, zo ti kpengo na ni kue a gué na mbâgë ti gati

en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.
sg: Ti kiri ti wara ngangu ti ala a lingbi ala zi ngangu so ala wara na mbâgë ti là ala zia ni nde.

en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".
sg: Ala yeke sara ni na tokuango mbeni kete mbâgë ti lumière so a iri ni photon.

en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.
sg: Azo ti senda ndara a iri ni « wâ so a tokua ni azä na peko ti tere », ngbanga ti so là ni atome ni, na mbeni lumière aga na pekoni, lumière ni so aza zango.

en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.
sg: Limo so aga afa a atome so a tokua a photon. A photon ni ayeke kete ahon ti so afa na lê ti limo so.

en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!
sg: A photon ayeke kete mingui ahon aye so a wara naya ti a atome.

en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.
sg: Ampoule ni abuba ndali ti so lo sara kua teti angbonga saki oko tongaso.

en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.
sg: A lingbi ti zia mbeni ampoule na place ni. Ala lingbi ti sara hange na ngoi ti lekengo ampoule ni.

en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.
sg: A lingbi ti mingo wâ ni wala a zi kamba ti wâ ni tonga so ape kamba ni ayeke fa.

en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.
sg: Wâ ti dada so ahon na yâ ti mbâgë ti ampoule so a sara na wen a peut ti sara si zo awara ngangu kpale tongana zo andu ni na mbâgë ti ya ni na ngoi so lo ngba na ya ti douille ni.

en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.
sg: Ye so asara si aye atambela nzoni nay a titere ayeke bê so a tokua mënë.

en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.
sg: Mënë alondo na bê lo gue na ti kota kamba ti tërë lo kiri na bë na lêgë ti kete kamba ti tërë. A kete kamba ti tërë so a yeke kete mingui a iri ni capilaire.

en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.
sg: A pembe ti mbeni triceratops lingbi ti nika nga fade a kugbe ma na nga a gake na a gunda so akpengba.

en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.
sg: A mbeni a wa sêndâyê a panzëe tongana a triceratops a te a cycadales, mbeni bangë so ayeke na tango ti Crétacé

en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.
sg: A mbagë ni so kpa gui kêtê keke ti mburu na mbeni kpoto ti a kugbe sa azä na ayeke na kî.

en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.
sg: Triceratops sara nga ngangu yângâ-ndeke ti lo ti gboto a kugbe kojo ni si le te ngbonga ti keke ni

en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.
sg: A mbeni a wa sendaye a tënë ti ala so a ke bangë so ayeke na ngonzo mingui, na fade a kpa yeso mbeni dinosaure a te ala, si meme laso a wasopo na a mbeni a yama tongana kûkurû (so ayeke halë ti a dinosaures) lingbi ti te a kugbe wara a lêkëkë ti ngonzo so.

en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.
sg: Tongana nye si sêkötä ti Io a lingbi ti gboto mbi? tongana ala lekere terê ti ala na lêndo ti Io, na fade nëngö ti ala ayeke na gbe ti nëngö ala na ndo ti sêse

en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.
sg: Zo so a nën 200 livres (90kg) na ndo ti sêse ayeke nën 36 livres (16 kg) tongana so na ndo ti Io. So ti tene sêkötä a gbota kêtê na ndo ti ala.

en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.
sg: Lâ ayeke na kêtê ndo so mo lingbi ti luti da pëpe tongana na ndo ti sêse. Lâ ayeke na mbö, na wa nga na plasma.

en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.
sg: Mbö ayeke ga kêtê sa so mo gue yongoro na bê ti lâ.

en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".
sg: Mbâgë ti gïgî so i yeke bâa, na tango so i yeke bâa la a iri ni photosphere , so a ye ti tene “kerebende ti wa”

en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.
sg: Ndurü na ngu na sake ota na peko ni, na ngu 1610, astronome ti ködörö sêse ti italie Galileo Galilei a a lekere telescope ti wese so Vénus ayeke na a kâpä tongana nze.

en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.
sg: A kâpäa yeke si ngbanga ti so na mbâgë ti Vénus(wara ti zne) so bâa ndo na mbagë ti la za. A kâpä ti Vénus a yo théorie Coernic na peko ti so a pälänête ayeke türünë na terê ti lâ.

en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.
sg: Ngu kêtê na peko ni, na 1639, mbeni astronome ti ködörö sêse ti grande bretagne so iri ti lo ayeke Jeremiah a wese kêtê ngoi ti Vénus.

en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.
sg: Kodro ti Angleterre a inga yongoro ngoi ti siriri na peko ti lakata ti Danelaw.

en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.
sg: Kamême, na 991, Ethelred a têngbi na mbeni kota mangbôkô ti a viking so a konon a hon a mangbôkô koue dipïi na tango ti Guthrum ngûngbangbo kojo.

en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.
sg: A schémas ti gbu ngo li so a gue na legue oko, ake a kodëkua so zärängö a kpälë so a bumbi a gba ti a bibê ou a mbênî ndokua ti tènè a wara a ndâkpälë.

en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.
sg: Na pekô ti kôzo Sïöpäsä ti a turûgu, Ethlered a ma tere na Olaf, so a kiri na Kodro sesse ti Norvege ti gui legue ti so benda na ndo ti ködörö-gbïä na benda wököngö-terê.

en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).
sg: Hangeul ayeke lafabëe oko so a lekere lo tënë ti sarango yê ti lakue.Lafabëe a bâa gigi na 1444 na gbe ti gbia Sejong( 1418 - 1450)

en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.
sg: Gbia Sejong ayeke fade gbia osio ti dynastie ti Joseon na a zo a ye lo mingi.

en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".
sg: Lo yeke fade zo so a zia iri ti lafabee Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum, so ya ye ti tene djoni toto ti fängö-yê na a zo ti korodro.

en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.
sg: A gba ti a theorie na ndo mayëre so si Sanskrit a bâa ndo. Oko ti popo ti ala ayeke tënë ti migration aryenne ti do na mbagë ti Inde si a ga na yanga ti ködörö na mbague ti ala.

en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.
sg: Sanskrit ayeke ngbêne yanga ti ködörö na nga a lingbi ti haka ni na yanga ti latin so a zo a ke tene na poto

en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.
sg: Kozo buku so a zo a inga ni a ya ti dunia asara ni na Sanskrit. Na peko ti compilation ti Upanishads, yanga ti Sanskrit a mîngo ngbanga ti molongö.

en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.
sg: Sanskrit ayeke yanga ti kodroro so ayeke zâkâri na yeke na mossoro, so yeke na nda ti a gba ti a yanga ti kododro ti a indiens ti laso, tongana latin so a na yeke na ngunda ti a yanga ti ködörö ti poto tongana français na expagnol.

en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.
sg: Na tango so bira ti la France hûnzi, ködörö sêse Allemagne a to nda lekere terê ti mû zûâ ti Grande-Bretagne.

en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.
sg: Ködörö sêse ti Allemagne a mû code ti gabä ti " « Opération Sealion ». Mingi ti a kota a ngombe na a gbakuru ti a turugu ti Grande Bretagne a girisa lani na tango ti sigi ti ala na Dunkerque, tënë ti so a turugu ayeke wawököngö.

en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.
sg: Kamême Royal Navy ayeke ngagu mingi a hon Marine ti Allemagne (« Kriegsmarine ») na nga ala kpa ti buba a mangbôkô so a ga ti läkätängö na mbage ti Manche.

en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.
sg: kamême, wüngö ti a mangbôkô ti Royal Navy so a duti ti na terê ti a lêgë ti läkätängö ayeke kêtê , ngbanga ti so a Amiraux yeke fade na mbito ti tene sua na mbeni gabä ti nduzu ti a allemand.

en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.
sg: Za i londo na mbeni mû ngo peko ti tene na ndo ti a piakua ti Italie. Italie ayeke fade "ngambe ti koli" ti Allemagne nga na Japon.

en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.
sg: A mbeni turugu nga na a marine ti wököngö ni ayeke da, Kamême, si ala lekere mangbôkô osio kozo ti birä.

en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.
sg: Ta biani bogoma ti Italie ayeke fade a ködörö ti a zo vuko. Ti mû ngo a ködörö ni so, lo ye fade ti wara mabôko tî eskalïe ti tene lo bi a gbâturugu, ti tene a la fa ngu ingo ti Méditerranée na ti mû Afrika.

en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.
sg: Tene ti so, ala zi base nga na a mangbôkô na ti grande bretagne na sêse ti Egypte. Gui a kua so, a cuirassé ti italie lingbi ti sara mbeni ye pëpe.

en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.
sg: Fade so ti Japon. Japon ayeke mbeni ködörö ti zua, tongana Grande Bretagne.

en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.
sg: A sous-marins ayeke a mangbôkô so a lekere ni ti tambala na gbe ti ngu na ti ngba na gbe ti ngu a ninga

en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.
sg: A sous-marins ayeke ye so a mû ti tiri na bira na ya ti kozo na ûse kota bira ti dunia II. Na tango ni lani ala yeke yeke na ngangu ti ala ayeke kêtê.

en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.
sg: Na to ngo nda ti bira ni, a la tambula na ndo ti ngu ingo, na yeke na yeke so si radar ni a to nda ti ga ngangu na ti ga mbîrîmbîrî, sa sous-marins a tonda ti linda na gbe ti ngu ti tene a bâa ala a pe

en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.
sg: A iri lani a sous-marins ti a Allemand U-Boats. A Allemand ayeke lani ngangu mingi na süängö na gi ndo ti a sous-marins ti ala.

en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.
sg: Na tënë ti benda ti ala na a sous-marins, a zo ayeke sara lani mäbê na a Allemand pëpe tënë ti so ala war gba ni na peko ti bira.

en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.
sg: Oui gbia ti Toutankhamon, so a iri fade lo "Gbia Tut" wara " Molenge ti gbia"ayeke oko ti a gbia ti Egypt so a inga lo mingi na ya ti dunia.

en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.
sg: Yeso ayeke zoni, a bâa fade lo tongana kota gbia ti ngoi kue pëpe na ga na su iri ti lo na ya ti buku ti a ngbêne gbia pëpe.

en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.
sg: Kamême,, wara ngo da ti kua ti lo na ngu 1922 a sara si lo nga mbeni zo so iri ti lo a wu. Na fade si a buba gba ti na a da kua na tango ni ka, da ti kua ti lo a ngba fade zoni.

en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.
sg: Mingi ti a gbakuru so a lu na Toutankhamon a ngba fade zoni, na fade si a lingbi ti wara a gbakuru so a sara ni na a wen na a tene ti mosoro.

en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.
sg: Lekerengö gerê ti gerêlâ a sara si a chars ti a Assyriens a yapu, na a mû loro ngagu na si a lingbi ti za maka na popo ti a turugu na a mbeni chars nga.

en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.
sg: Kokora ti a arbalètes ti kua a lingbi fade ti linda armure ti a turugu ti a wakâmâ-kîte. Ayeke na ngu 1000 kozo ti JC, si a Assyriens a sigi na kozo gbâmbârâtâ.

en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.
sg: Gbâmbârâtâa ayeke a turugu so a gue na bira na a mbârâtâ. Na fade na tango ni ka mbata ade ti bâa gigi pëpe, a gbâmbârâtâ a tiri na ndo ti peko ti mbârâtâ so ayeke senge

en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.
sg: Na inga gba ti a wapororo, a wasêndâyê, a wasêndâgao ti ködörö ti grece. Na fade zo so a inga lo mingi na ya ti hingango-mbeti ayeke, Homère, waziba na wapagao nzömbai, so a sara chefs-d'œuvre ti sêndâsû ti a grecque: A pagao ti Iliade na ti Odyssée.

en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.
sg: Sophocle na Aristophane ayeke a dramaturges halëzo na nga a mapîâ ni a ga fade a kota kua ti sêndâsû na ya ti dunia.

en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.
sg: Mbeni to grecque mathématicien iri ti lo ayeke Pythagore, lo so a inga lo mingi tene ti théorème ti lo so ayeke na ndo ti a kambisa ti a terê ti triangles rectangles.

en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.
sg: Na fade a mbeni mëkängö ndê ti wungo ti a zo so a ke tene ti hindi. A zo a mëkängö so lo yeke na popo ti ûse wara osio yanga-ködörö so a so a tënë mingi na ya ti dunia.

en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.
sg: Wungo ti a watenengo ti ködörö ni ayeke tongana so i diko wara nga pëpe na a watenengo so a ga nduru.

en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.
sg: A mëkängö ni a fa so wungo ti a watenego yanga ti ködörö ni ayeke na popo ti kutu 340 na kuto 500, na a nga a zo kutu 800 a lingbi nga ti ma yanga ti ködörö ni.

en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.
sg: Yanga ti hindi na Urdu ayeke oko na ya ti vocabulaire ti ala na gna ala yeke ndê ya ti su ngo ala. Na ya ti a patara ti lakue, a watenego ti a yanga ti ködörö ûse so a lingbi nga ti ma terê ti ala.

en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.
sg: Nduru na ngungbangbo ti 15e, Estonie ti banga ayeke fade na ti lenge-ngangu ti hingingo-mbeti ti Allemagne.

en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.
sg: A mbeni a müâne ti Allemagne a ye fade ti pusu nduru nzapa na terê ti a waködörö, na fade a la sigigi na yanga ti litterale estonienne.

en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.
sg: Ngunda ni ayeke na ndo lafabëe ti Allemagne na mbeni gerêsû “Õ/õ” a za na ndo.

en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.
sg: Ngoi na ngoi, A dêfa mingi ti a mbupa ti allemand so a bubi ni. Ayeke fade tongo nda ti warango-yingo.

en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.
sg: Na ya ti ngôbo, wamäda ti ngendegbia a lingbi ti linda turugu na peko ti manda ngo mbeti ti lo.

en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).
sg: Kamême, Charles a gue na senda gigi ti Trinity College ti Cambridge so lo manda anthropologie na archéologie, na peko ni mbai na lo wara 2:2 ( mbeni makandâ ti classe ûse ti gbeni).

en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.
sg: Charles ayeke fade kozo wa sewa ti gbia ti angleterre ti wara ngo makanda so.

en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.
sg: Turquie ti poto (ti Thrace to wara ti Rumélie na ya ti péninsule balkanique) ayeke na 3% ti ködörö ni.

en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.
sg: Ködörö ti Turquie a ahön a kilomètre 1600 (1000 mi) ti kota mbage nga na km 800 (500 mi) ti kêtê mbage na saterê so ayeke tongana rectangle.

en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.
sg: Lêndo ti turquie, na a ngûlëndë, a mû 783 562 kilomètres carrés (300,948 milles carrés), na si 755 688 kilomètres (291,773 milles carrés) na Asie ti mbongo-do na 23,764 kilomètres carrés (9,174 milles carrés) na poto.

en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.
sg: Lêndo ti Turquie ayeke 37 kota ködörö ti dunia na lo yeke tongana sêlê so a bungbi France na Royaume-Uni réunis.

en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.
sg: Turquie ayeke ngoro na a ngu ingo na mbage ti terê ti lo ota. Ngu ingo ti Égée na do, ngu ingo ti vuku na banga na ngu ingo ti Méditerranée mbongo.

en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.
sg: Luxembourg ayeke na yongoro mbai mais lipandäa ti lo ayeke na ngu 1839.

en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.
sg: A mbage ti ködörö sêse ti Belgique ti fade so ayeke lana mbage ti Luxembourg ando mais a ga fade so ti belgique na peko ti Revelotion ti a Belge na ngu 1830

en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.
sg: Luxembourg a tara lakue ti ngba ködörö so ayeke ndê,mais a mû lo na ya ti kozo bira ti dunia na ga na ûse bira ti dunia, Allemagne a mû lo.

en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.
sg: Na ngu 1957, Luxembourg a ga kota walekerengo bungbi ti organization so iri a ga laso Union européenne.

en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).
sg: Drukgyal Dzong ayeke ngagu ti fütïngö ndo na mbeni a wa-nzapa na ya ti gbata ti Paro ( na ya ti kêtê gbata ti Phondey).

en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.
sg: A tënë fade na ngu 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel a lekere forteresse ti sara matanga ti benda ti lo na ndo ti a ngangu ti tibéto-mongoles.

en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
sg: Na ngu 1951, mbeni tögbïngö-wa a za a tanga ti Drukgyal Dzong, tongana limo ti Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.
sg: Na peko ti tögbïngö-wa, a bata forteresse fadeso, lo ga ndo so a gboto a zo na pendere ye ti Bhoutan.

en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.
sg: Na ngu ngbangbo 18e, Cambodge a kalêe na popo ti a ngangu mba ti lo, Thaïlande na nga Vietnam.

en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.
sg: A zo ti ködörö sêse ti Thailande a mû fade Cambodge lêgë mingi na ngu ngbangbo 18 nga na ngu 1772 na a la buba Phnom Phen.

en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.
sg: Na ya ti a tanga ti ngu ti ngu ngbangbo 18e, a Vietnamiens nga a mû Cambodge.

en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.
sg: Bale oko ma miambe pourcent ti a zo ti ködörö sêse ti Venezuala ayeke na kua pëpe, na mingi ti ala so a sara kua a sara na ya ti könömï so a iri informel.

en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.
sg: A zo ûse na ndo ti ota na ködörö sêse ti Venezuala so a sara kua a sara ni na ya ti a ndo ti sarawîsi, nduru a oko na ndo ti osio a sara kua na ya ti izini nga na oko na ndo ti oku ayeke na ya ti kua ti yaka.

en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.
sg: Izini so ayeke ngangu mingi tënë ti a Vénézuéliens ayeke pétrole, so si ködörö ni ayeke sara ni kamême si gi oko na ndo ti ngbangbo ti a so la a sara kua na ya ni.

en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.
sg: Na tongo ndati ti lipandäa ti ködörö ni, kode kua ti a zaradäa ti sêndâsên ti Singapour a mû lêgë fade ti tene a gbian ndo-mbutu ni na zaradäa ti ködörö ti la.

en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.
sg: Na ngu 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, a soro mbeni hybride d'orchidée tongana kongö ti ködörö ni.

en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.
sg: Lakue na nze ti octobre, nduru a 1,5 kutu ti a watëngö-pêrë a gue na ya ti ngonda ti mbongo, ala hon na ya ti bale ti Mara, dipïi a hötö ti banga tene ti ngu nzapa.

en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.
sg: Na fade kiri ngo ni an mbage ti banga an ya ti do, lêgë oko ala fa bale ti Mara, na peko ti ngu nzapa ti nze ti ngubë.

en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.
sg: A ndo ti Serengeti ayeke na bäï ti ködörö ti Serengeti, ndo i bata ngo ti Ngorongoro na ti bata ti gïngö-nyama ti Maswa na Tanzanie na nga na bata ti Maasai Mara na Kenya.

en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)
sg: Manda ngo ti sarango kuasango interactif a hunda a kode kua na lêgë tî mângbi na ti ngôbo, nga na a gbakuru ti a mandango mbeti ( storyboarding, singa me na singa le, na tene ngo lisoro).

en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.
sg: Sara ngo ye so ayeke interactive a ye fade si ala haka a hypothèse na ndo ti a sara ngo ye ti kuasango na nga ala yeke manda lêgë ti gbu ngo li ti ala na lêgë ti mayëre so ayeke non-linéair.

en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.
sg: Sara ngo ye so ayeke interactive a ye fade ti tene a ye ti pialö a tingbi terê ti ala oko na oko, na nga ala yeke na sêyêtara so ayeke mbeni entité so ayeke nzoni.

en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.
sg: Sioni ye ti bogoma ti zoom ayeke so complexité focale na nga a wungo ti a lê yê a hunda ti tene a wara mbeni plage ti a kota yongo so ayeke focale na ayeke ngangu mingi tene ti a lê yê so ayeke na focale fixe.

en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.
sg: A ga kêtê na kêtê kpale ngbanga ti so a wasarango lentille a wara a ngangu sêndïä na ya ti sara ngo a lentille.

en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.
sg: A mû fade lêgë na a lê yê ti zoom ti sara a limo so kalitëe so a kpa a lo so wara a lê yê ti focale fixe.

en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.
sg: Mbeni sioni ye ti a zoom ayeke zingo ti lo kota ( sêlörö) ti lê yê ni ayeke fade wokongo.

en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.
sg: Yeso a sara si a lê yê ti zoom ayeke na ngere ngangu pëpe na ayeke ngangu ti mû lo ti sara na kua na ndo so la ayeke da pëpe tene ti so lo yeke na flash pëpe.

en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.
sg: Oko ti a kpalé so ike wara na ngoi ti gbïänngö limo na DVD a yeke hon ngo ndo ti tataralimo

en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.
sg: A leke gba ti a singalè ti za nguia na bè ti a zo.

en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.
sg: Tènè tiso , ye so kue ala ba na ndo ti sîngalê a yeke na yângâ so a fâ ni, na ndouzou, na gbéni nga na tèrè ni.

en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.
sg: A leke ye so a yeke ti tongona limo ni a mu tatârâ lîmo kue. A ke ye so ë iri ni hon ndo ti tataralimo.

en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.
sg: Mawa ni a ke ti so, töngana mo lèkè DVD, â yanga ti tèrè ni a yéké fa nga, na tongana limo a yéké na a mbéni a mbéti ti diko ngo ni na gbé ni sô a ke na sésé mingui, a mbéti sô a ke sigui andé koue apè.

en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.
sg: Chateau ti médiéval ngôbo a gboto pupu ti lo la ni na ya ti sümä, a fa a limo ti a joutes, ti a matângana a chevalerie Arthurienne.

en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.
sg: Kameme lo luti na popo ti a fütïngö ti millénaires, a yeke senge ti tene lo da be ti lo na toto nga na a fîon ti ngbêne bira anînga dipïi, ba nga ma ngo guere ti a mbarata na ndo ti tênë na mä ngo fîon ti mbeto so a londo na ya ti a du ti a donjons.

en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?
sg: Ka tongana bibe ti e a yeke nga na ndo ti ta tene? ngbanga ti nye a lekere a chateaux kojo? A lekere ala tongana nye ?

en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.
sg: Pande ti ngoi ni, château ti Kirby Muxloe ayeke mbeni ngangu da a hon taâ château.

en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.
sg: A kota fûru ti lo ayeke na tatärä na nga a ngengo derê ti lo a lingbi nga fade ti luti koli na koli tnene ti yongoro ngoi na mbeni gabä pëpe.

en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.
sg: Na ya ti a ngu 1480, na tango Lord Hastings, so a tonda ti lekere lo, ködörö ni ayeke fade na ya ti siriri na fade a hunda batango lo tene ti a kêtê bungbi ti a wanzï tî lê-kôbe ti tokua.

en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.
sg: Lïngbïngö ti ngunu ayeke fade na ya ti a ködörö ti poto so a gi ti bata sêwane ti a ködörö ti a letäa ti poto kue.

en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.
sg: Concept ni ayeke fade so a ködörö ti poto a lingbi ti kanga lêgë na mbeni ködörö ti tene a ga ngangu, na fade a govoroma ti ködörö a gbian bungbi ti ala ti tene ala bata lïngbïngö na popo ti ala.

en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.
sg: Bira ti müngö-mbätä ti espagne a mû lêgë na kozo bira so fade si bê ti pkale ayeke lïngbïngö ti a ngunu.

en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.
sg: Ye ni so a fa ngangu gbian ngo ni, ngbanga ti so a wapoto a lingbi fade ti wara lêgë ti gue na bira ti nzapa pëpe. Tongana so si, bira ti ngo bale ota ayeke tanga to bira so a iri ni bira ti jua ti nzapa.

en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.
sg: A buba lani danzapa ti Artémis na Éphèse na lango 21 ti nze ti lêngoa na ngu 356 kozo ti ngoi ti i na ya ti mbeni wa ti gino so Hérostrate a sara ni.

en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.
sg: Na peko ti mbai yeso a pusu lo ayeke yango iri so lo ye fade. A bi vundü na bê ti Ephésiens , na a la tene ayeke su iri ti Hérostrate na ya ti buku pëpe.

en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.
sg: Wasêndâdünîa grec so iri ti lo ayeke strabon su iri ni na peko ni , tandi ni la i inga ni laso. Danzapa ni a futi na bi na lango ti dungo Alexandre le Grand.

en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.
sg: Na tango so Alexande ayeke gbia lo hunda ti tongana a lekere da-nzapa na a ke yeso lo hunda so. Nga na peko ti kua ti Alexandre , lekere da-nzapa na ngu 323 kozo ti tango so ike da.

en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.
sg: Ala sara si maboko ti ala ayeke wököngö si a pika a mbeti so- na fade ala tara ti yëngïngö terê ti ala na maboko pëpe.

en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.
sg: Na lêgë ni so, a na ke nzêen mingi pëpe. Na nga a la girisa pëpe ti pika touche ni a ngangu ti tene ti warango konongo ti lego ni tongana ti kâlângbâ.

en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.
sg: Na ndo ti accordéon ti tene a wara mbeni lego ndê ala lingb ti uru pupu na ya ti sao na ngangu wara na loro.

en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.
sg: Mysticisme ayeke fade gi ngo lêgë ti kömïön, ti zoroko wara li ti hinga ngo ye ti ta tene, ti sênzapä, ti ta tene ti yingo wara ti nzapa.

en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.
sg: Wamabe ayeke gi mbeni tarango kodë biaku, mbeni hinga ngo ye wara bango ndo a ta tene ti nzapa wara ti a nzapa.

en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.
sg: A wamabe ayeke gi a mbeni lêgë ti se duti wara a saragon ye ti tene ala kono hinga ngo ye.

en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.
sg: Mysticisme ayeke ndê na lêgë ti a mbeni a saterê ti mango na be na a ye ti nzapa so a za hënë na ndo ti a hinga ngo ti zo veni biaku, na ayeke fade na gerêsû so ayeke kpô, mbirimbiri, a djere wara extatique.

en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.
sg: Sikhisme ayeke mbeni nzapa ti sous -continent ti Inde. Lo wara ngunda ti lo na ya ti a gbaködörö ti Pendjab a ngu ngbangbo 15 na lêgë ti mbeni kangbingo na ya ti ngôbo ti a hindou.

en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.
sg: A sikhs a bâa mabe ti ala tongana mbeni nzapa so ayeke ndê na hindouisme, kamême, si a la hinga so ngunda na a ngôbo ni a londo na ya ti hindou.

en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.
sg: A sikhs a iri nzapa ti a ala Gurmat, so ti tene Pendjabi " lego ti a gourou". Gourou ayeke mbeni lê ti a nzapa kue ti inde, na nga sikhisme, lo mû ngangu ti sara mboma ti mango na bê ti sikhes.

en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.
sg: Zo so a lekere Nzapa ni na ngu ngbangbo 15 ayeke Gourou Nanak(1469-1539). Na peko ni ala wara a guru goumbaya.

en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.
sg: Kamême, na nze ti föndo ngu 1956, a zêndo ti Krouchtchev a za ayeke na tara gbanga ti a wûrûwûrû so a londo na Pologne, wara a wa-kua a londo fade tene ti ngangu tiango, ti kobe na bi ngo nginza tî nze na sêse si a gbian ni na mbeni kengo ye na terê ti a communisme.

en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.
sg: Atâa so, na hunzi ngo ni , Krouchtchev a tokua a mbarata ti tene a gue a kiri na molongö, lo yeda na a mbeni hunda ngo ti könömï na lo yeda ti soro zo so a hinga lo mingi Wladyslaw Gomulka tongana kozo wayenda.

en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.
sg: Civilisation ti ya ti pöpö-hötö ti Indus ayeke civilisation ti ngu ti bronze na ya ti kêtê-gbata ti banga-do so a bumbi a kota terê ti Pakistan na a mbeni a gbata ti banga-do ti inde na ti banga-tö ti Afghanistan.

en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.
sg: Civilisation a konon na ya ti a dûsembë ti Indus, so lo wara iri ti lo.

en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.
sg: Nga si a gbati a wagingo ndo a bâa ti ala tene civilisation a tondani nga na ya pöpö-hötö ti bale ti Sarasvati, na laso bale ni a ule, a lingbi fade ti iri lo Indus-Sarasvati, na a mbeni a iri lo civilisation ti harappéenne na peko ti Harappa, kozo lêndo so a a gi ya ni na ya ti ngu 1920.

en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.
sg: Gigi ti a militariste ti gbâködörö-va ti a romain a sara si a ye ti nganga a gue na nduzu.

en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.
sg: Gbia ti a gbia August a tonda ti mû a wanganga na lo sara kozo Terê ti a Nganga ti a Romain so a lingbi ti sara kua na peko ti a bira.

en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.
sg: A wasürüngö a hinga gbati a yoro tongana morphine so a gboto lo na ya ti a le keke ti pavot na scopolamineso a wara lo na ya ti a keke ti herbier.

en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.
sg: Ala ga fade a ngangu na fango ye ti tene ala soo a zo ti kobela na ya ti gangrène na nga si na lêgë ti garrot na clamps arteriels ti tene a sara fasîni ti flux ti mênë.

en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.
sg: Na ndo ti a gbati ti a ngu ngbangbo, gbâködörö-va ti rome a sara a kota ye na ya ti mäda ti nganga na lo lekere kota mbage ti hingango ndo so i hing laso.

en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.
