sg: Origami Pureland a yeke origami na dïmïnïngö so ngôngbïa lingbi ti sara lêgë oko, a ngôngbï so a kpengba tongana ngôngbï so a bâa na gbeni a yeda na ni pëpe, na a ngôngbï ayeke na a ndo so ayeke sêngê.

en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.
sg: John smith a sara fade lo na ngu 1970 ti tene a mû lêgë na a lingendê tene ti a a zo so a hinga kua mingi pëpe.

en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.
sg: A melenge a mai na hingango ndo na ndo ti a mara na a stéréotypes ti mara na tango so a la de melenge na a stéréotypes ti mara so ayeke na sioni na ndo ti sarango ye ti ala.

en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.
sg: Na tapande, a melenge so a bâa terê ti ala tongana a kêtê a mara la lêgë ti stéréotype ayeke na kpale ti mandango mbeti na da mbeti tongana ala inga stéréotype so a bungbi na mara ti ala.

en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.
sg: MySpace a yeke ota site web so, a zo a sara ni mingui na États-Unis na lo yeke na ngüdango 54 ti a zo fadesô.

en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.
sg: A ngbanda tere a ngboto Tasîon ti a zo mingui, mingui ni na ya ti ngisë ti fängö-yê.

en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.
sg: A site Web so a yeke na a djoni lê, tongana legue ti leke ngo lêmbëtï ti mbu so a lingbi ti yôro a blogs, a limo na a mbeni legue ti sara ngo ye.

en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.
sg: Linda ngo na ya lêmbëtï so a yeke wököngö legue ti fa ngo adresse web, ye so a sara ni wököngö ti tene mo bata na ti pika tene ti a wa manda ngo mbeti so a lingbi ti wara kpale na pika ngo clavier ni wara sêsüngö.

en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.
sg: Si fade a lingbi ti lekele lo ti tongana si a ga wököngö ti tènè a diko na nga a lingbi ti sa a nzorôko da, tongana ala a.

en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".
sg: Wûsûwusu ti tïängö ti attention " ayeke syndrome neurologique" so si kobela ni ayeke impulsivité, distractibilité na l'hyperactivité wara ndömbâ ti ngangu.

en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".
sg: Wûsûwusu ti attention ayeke wûsûwusu mandango ye pëpe; lo gbu 3 ti si na 5% ti a melenge, tongana ti si na kutu 2 (ûse) ti a melenge ti ködörö ti Amerique.

en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.
sg: A melenge so ayeke na TDA, ayeke na kpale ti duti kpo ti sara a kua ti mbeti na ala lingbi ti duti kpo gi na ya ti a ye so ala ye, tongana sara ngia wara bango dessins animes wara sara ngo mbeti sans ponctuation.

en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.
sg: A melenge so ayeke sara ye tongana ala yeke na kpale mingi, ngbanga ti so ala yeke sara ye so a rîsiki, ala yeke tiri na a luti koli na koli na a kotazo ti tene ala haka kpe ti li ti ala, gbanga ti so kpe ti li ti ala a lingbi ti haka na lêgë ti sêlêgë pëpe.

en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.
sg: TDA a buba duti ngo ti ala na a mba ti ala ngbanga ti so a mbeni a melenge a lingbi ti hinga ngbanga ti ala yeke sara a ye tongana so pëpe wara ngbanga ti nye ala yeke diko mbeti tongana so wara ngbanga ti nye sêgümbängö ti ala ayeke ndê.

en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.
sg: Tongana ngangu ti warango a hinga ngo ndo na ti manda ngo a gbian ngbobo so i fa na nzuzu, wungo ti ngunda ni so wara hinga ngo ndo a gbian.

en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.
sg: Lêgë ti warango sango ayeke fade ndê. Ngangu ayeke mbeni pëpe na yati da ngo bê ti zo veni, nga ngangu ti dabê na gere mbeti a ga kozo ye.

en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.
sg: Kozo ni si, Renaissance a ga na ngangu gbian na ya ti manda no ye na ti tokua ngo hingango ye.

en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.
sg: A hon fade si na a mbeni primate so, a hominidés mû maboko ti ala ti tambula pëpe, nengo ti ala wara hingingo ti ala na lêgë ti a keke.

en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.
sg: Maboko na gere ti makako ayeke na yongo lêgë oko, so ti tene ala mû maboko ti ala ti yo na nengo ti ala na tango ti tambula.

en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.
sg: Maboko ti zo ayeke nduru a hon gere ti lo na a phalange so ayeke doroäa.

en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.
sg: Bio ti maboko ngbêne fossile ti ngu ûse wara ota ti kutu a fa gbian ngo ti maboko so ayeke fade tene ti tambula.

en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.
sg: A mbeni a zo a bâa ti ala a tene a gbati a sümä so zo a wara mbirimbiri a lingbi ti sara si ala nzêen.

en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.
sg: Nda ti ye so ayeke pendâ ti sümä ti mbirimbiri si ayeke gboto ngbonga na ya ti sê ni ti REM.

en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.
sg: Na a REM kete na bi, sê ni so ala yeke tara lango na terê ti ala a wara ngangu ti tene a ga nga kpälë pëpe.

en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.
sg: Ayeke bi nzêenna terê ti ala tongana ala zingo lakue na ya ti pënzëngbonga bale ûse wara bale ota na ngoi so ala yeke bâa limo.

en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.
sg: pendâ ni ayeke na ndo ti fréquence so si kpe ti li ti ala ayeke gi lêgë ti wara sümä na bi.

en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.
sg: Yé ni a tamboula djoni apè tènè ti a zo ti séssé ti Italie na séssé ti Africa ti banga na tongo nda ni. Gui na tongo nda ti yenga na peko ti depa ti bira na lango ti 10 na nze ti föndo ti ngu 1940, a turûgu ti Angleterre a kamata Capuzzo na séssé ti Libye.

en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.
sg: Na ya ti dö ngo guere na Bardia ti tö, a turûgu ti grande bretagne a gbû mokonzi wa kodè ti turûgu ti Italie, kota wa kamba Lastucc.

en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.
sg: Na lango ti 28 ti nzè ti Föndo, Maréchal Italo, kota Mokonzi ti kodro sésé ti Libye so a yeke na mbague wamada ti Mussolini a wara kûâ na yâ ti bira na sésé ti Tobruk.

en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.
sg: Ngia ti awanguru ti escrime ayeke sara na a gba ti a wa mandango ye a manda na da senda gigi na a Kuta mandako.

en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.
sg: Ngia ti wangiuru so ayeke sara ni gui a zo use, zo ti tiri ti zembe a yeke tingbi na mbeni nga.

en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.
sg: Golf ayeke mbeni ngia so a oua tango ndembo ni ayeke boumbi tere na oko ti pika a ndembo ni na ti a dou.

en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.
sg: Dou bale oko na miombe a mu lege ti ta ndembo,a oua tango ndembo ni a to nda ni na kozo dou ti ounzi na tanga ni bale oko na miombe.

en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.
sg: Watango ndembo so a sala kete mangboro wala kota mangboro ti ketke ti pika ngo na ndembo so a ounzi ndembo ti lo si lo la lo so benda.

en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.
sg: A yeke sara ngia so gui na ndo ti péré,nga péré ni ayeke na tere ti dou so ya ni a gboto ndourou si a iri ni "green"

en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.
sg: Mbeni ye ti pendere ndo so ayeke ti lakwe ayeke lo so si a zo a boumbi ti voyage:Pendere ndo ti sala ngo ngia.

en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.
sg: Ayeke na ngoi so la a zo a goue na mbeni ndo so ayeke nde ti gigi ti ala ti lakoue lakoue ti sala ngia.

en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.
sg: A yanga ti ngou mboutou,a ndo batango a gnama nga na a kete lando ayeke a ndo so azo ayeke goue da mingi ti sala ngui.

en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.
sg: Tongana ndali ti ba ngo mbeni ndo so ayeke nde ti hinga mbai nga na aye ti a kotara,a lingbi aye ti pendere ndo so a hinga ni na iri ti pendere ndo ti a ye ti kotara.

en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.
sg: A touristes a lingbi ti goue ti ba a mbeni ndo nde ti mbeni kodoro nde ouala a la lingbi sengue ti soro mbeni senda kode gui oko.

en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.
sg: Amundju poro, a ba a kusala so, ala iri nga a zo ti mungo maboko.

en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).
sg: A turugu a leke tere ti ala ngangu i goe na dawant ayeke kozo na ota boumbi ti ala ti New Hampshire ti a zo ngbangbo use, na gbe ti komandema ti a wa kamba Jonh Stark na James Reed (ala use kue ala yeke ga ande a wa tongolo).

en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.
sg: A zo ti Stark a mu ndo na tere ti gbagba nduru na bongo so a munzu poro ayeke da.

en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.
sg: Tongana a ndo ti ngu a zi mbeni ye tongana gbagba na tere ti kete ngu Mystic na tere ti bongo-toh ti péninsule, ala yo gbagba ni hio tongasso na mbeni kete tere ti da ti tene na bongo a hunzi na tere ti ngu na ndo ti a mbutu.

en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.
sg: Gridley wala Stark a lu mbeni nduru keke so guere ni a ga nduru na ngbangbo oko (30 m) na dawan ti gbagba na a mu yanga na zo oko pepe ti gboto juska a ti so ayeke nzoni aga a hon ala.

en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.
sg: Kode ti a americain a yeke na ndo ti zingo yanga ti tiri na ya ti a lege ndende ota.

en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.
sg: Watongolo John Cadwalder ayeke zi yanga ti mbeni tiri ti kangbi ngo ya ti azo na ndo ti a turugu ti britanique na Bordentown, ti tene a kanga lege na a zo ti mungo maboko kue.

en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.
sg: Watongolo James Ewing a gana a turugu kpale 700 na mbage ti kete ngu na Trenton Ferry, a mu tere ti gbagbara na ndo ti kete ngu Assunpink na a kanga lege na a wato ti tene a kpe.

en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.
sg: A turugu ti bira so hungo ti ala a yeke 2 400 a fa kente ngu na sake gumbaya na bongo ti Trenton, nga a kagbi na bongbi use, oko na gbe ti Greene na mbeni na gbe ti Sullivan, ti tene a zi yanga ti mbeni tiri na kota ndapelele.

en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.
sg: Na hongo ti ti quart na demi-mile, loro ni a ga mingi pepe na sarango ngangu a ga ye so ayeke ti nzoni.

en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.
sg: nzoni kue, mbeni demi-miler ti kozo da, zo so alingbi ti tiri penze ngbonga use, a lingbi ti duti na nzoni gangu loro, na mbage ngangu ni a lingbi ti manda na a ya ti a kpale kue.

en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.
sg: Sara a tambela na guere kete na goe ti de, bongbi na kousala ti gymnastique tene ti a tere, ayeke pendere lekere ngo tere tene ti ngoi ti tambela.

en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.
sg: Lege ti tengo a nzoni kobe ayeke mu ngangu, alingbi nga ti ga nzoni nda li ti a masseka wanguru ti kpengo loro.

en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.
sg: Batango nzoni duti, lege ti batango tere na nzoni ngu nga na mango ya ti a nzere nzere ye alingbi ti mu maboko na a wanguru ti kpengo loro ti wara ngia.

en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.
sg: Loro ti demi-fond ayeke mbeni ngia ti wanguru so ngure ni a hou pepe, a gba ti a gbu ngo li so ayeke na lege ni pepe tene ti a mbeni ye ti bongbi so a ko na ni.

en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.
sg: A ye ti kousala so a lingbi ti vo tongana a yeni, na mbage gbani mingi a yeke wara kete wala kete ngangu ni na ndo ti a ngangu.

en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.
sg: Awanguru ti loro a lingbi ti tene a ye mbeni ye a hon kue nzoni ni ayeke da pepe.

en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.
sg: Atome alingbi ti duti tongana mbeni ye ti nzoni tene ti a ye kousala kue.

en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.
sg: Ayeke mbeni boumbi ngo ayeke ngangu si ayeke boumbi, tongana mbeni Bohr, ti mbeni noyau central na orbite na tere ti electron, ambeni kete so a kpa tere na a planete na orbite na tere ti la. Fango ye 1,1.

en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.
sg: Noyau a boumbi aye use - a neutrons na a protons.

en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.
sg: A protons ayeke na a ngangu ti wa si a neutrons a yeke na gba ti ngangu peep. Electrons ayeke gui na kete ngangu ti wa.

en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.
sg: Ti hinga zo so a wara kpale, ala lingbi ti gui ti ba ndo ni nga ti bata siriri ti ala.

en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.
sg: Ala lingbi ti hinga ndo so zo ti warango kpale a yeke da tongana ala ga nduru na lo na a ye kue ti dekongo

en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.
sg: Tongana ala wara ka na lege so ala yeti mu maboko na zo, ala yeke kono kpale ni.

en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.
sg: Mandago ye afa na gigi kobela ti li, mbeto nga na kota buba ngo ti ye na popo ti songo ye na wokongo ti ye na mbegue ti a zo so a ba passi na songo peko.

en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.
sg: Oko ngangu ti kota buba ngo ti ye, na pepe kobela ti li na mbeto, ayeke ngangu na sarango a kusala ti yenga ti AP lakue.

en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.
sg: Ala so ayeke na a kusala lakue ti sara aye pepe ti wara assongo tere, kangbi ya ti a songo tere ngangu na sarango ya tire so ayeke nzo ni.

en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.
sg: Bango ndo, wala ngangu ti bango ndo, a lingbi na ye ti tere ti zo ti bango ndo so ayeke ti le.

en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.
sg: A gba ti ye ti le ahon ndoni ndengue na ndengue, so na ya ni ngangu ni a lingui na sara ngo kousala ti tere ti zo.

en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.
sg: Aye ndende so aleke a yeke na ngangu ndende, ayeke nde na aye ti guere pupu, ala lingbi nga ti tene a sara ni nde ti mu lege na mbeni kapa so ali nde gbani nga ti ara kusala na kode.

en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.
sg: Bongbi ti a zo ayeke bongbi ngo tere nde na mbeni ndo ti duti.

en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.
sg: Tongana a zo ndende ti ya ti kodoro ayek oko ye so a ba sara ngo ye ti tere ti ala ayeke oko, atene ala yeke gui oko.

en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.
sg: Tongana a zo a fa sara ngo ye ti tere ti ala ndende, ala yeke nde.

en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.
sg: Bongbi ti a mini a tambula si a kangbi ya ti ala ndende.

en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.
sg: Na kangbi ngo ni nde nde, a mini a tambula na bi nga ala luti na kando oko ti hu tere ti ala na kuta la.

en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.
sg: A bongbi ti ala ni atondani ti kagbi tere ti ala ndende tongana hungo ti akobe ti ala a kiri na peko. Na ya kagbi so, a la ke lekere a kete a da ti lango ti ala so ala yeke gbian na ya ti alango oko oko.

en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.
sg: Oko oko ti a wa buba ngo ye so wala a zo ti tambula so alingbi nduru na lango 17.

en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.
sg: Nye la ayeke kete bumbi? Tene ti bumbi ayeke mbeni mbupa ti yanga ti latin "cella" atene "kete da", so aba gigi kozo na awasenda ye asara kua na microscope ti ba na a kete a mbeni ye ti liège.

en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.
sg: Kete bumbi ayeke a mbeni bongbi ngo tere ti a zo,nga aye ti tere ti zo gbani mingi.

en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".
sg: Ahon kue, bumbi ayeke a kete ye so a yeke ngangu na lege ti mandango ye ti gigi so a iri a bazanguele ti bubi ti gigi.

en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.
sg: Aye ti ya ti Li a bata homéostasie na a toka a ngonzo na ya ti tere kue ti mu ngangu na tambulango ti mene ti tene a buba pepe.

en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.
sg: Angonzo so alingbi tokua hio na ya ti tere, sa a mu maboko ti bata tere ti zo ngbanga i a ye ti kpale ti ngangu.

en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.
sg: A ngangu pupu a buba mbeni kete ndo a hon abeni kete pupu ti ngangu, a hon kue ala lingbi ti buba aye na ndo lege ti hon ngo ti ala.

en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.
sg: A kota pupu ti ngangu a zi a gunda ti a keke, a zi a keke ti guere ti da na ayo a kutukutu na le ti nduzu. Na ya ti ngbangbo oko ti a pupu ti ngangu use na popo ni a ninga ngbonga ota.

en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
sg: A mangboro ti pupu ayeke na a pupu so alingbi ti si na brassi km/h 480 (133m/s; 300 mph)

en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.
sg: Azo a lekere na a sara a ye ti bango ndo so a kono a ndo ngu mingi.

en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.
sg: Na ngoi so, a kozo a gbakuru ti limo a lekere ni na sese ti europa na nda ngu ngungbangbo 16.

en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.
sg: A gbakuru ti limo a sara tingbi ngo ti ala use ti fa na gigi ambeni gbakuru o ayo nga ayeke nduru si a kono.

en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly
sg: Be ti ye na kota be ayeke lakue na e na si ayeke gigi ti bongbi ngo ti tene gba ti mbage ti a zo a wara.

en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.
sg: Hinga so gba ti azo a ba a tene nzoni duti ngo a ninga ayeke ti sara kusala na a mbeni.

en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.
sg: Gba ti a zo a ba li mbeni la wala a zo a yeke sara tambula ti gu na mbeni tongolo na ti ba mbeni dounia, ambeni a hunda tere ti ala nye la ayeke ka, ambeni a ba atene a toro wala a mbeni ye so a kpa dounia a yeke na ndo mbeni sessse.

en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".
sg: Na mbage, tongana a si, ayeke kpa ti tene a si kozo ni a yo mingi. A tongolo a kangbi mingi sa a gba ti na gba ti a kilometre na popo ti a tongolo o ayeke nduru na tere.

en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?
sg: Wala la oko, a tara ti ala ayeke duti na ndo ti mbeni dunia ti kpene na ala ke hunda tere na ndo a kotara i ala.

en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.
sg: Anyama ayeke na tere mingi. Ala te aye na ala yapu tere na ya ni. Gba ti a nyama alingbi ti hon.

en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).
sg: A yeke gui a nyama si ayeke na kpi ti li (a hon kue tongana a nyama kue la ayeke na ni pepe);

en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.
sg: A wara a nyama na ndokue na le sese. Ala zi du na ya sese, ti ngu na ya ngu ingo na ala huru na nduzu

en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.
sg: Mbeni kete tere a yeke ta kete mbeni ye so ayeke sara kousala tene ti tere ti zo so angba na fifi (ti a ye)

en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.
sg: Mbeni a gana mbage ti latin a fa a tene kete gbakuru.

en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.
sg: Tongana ala a kete tere so angba na fini na massini, ala so a sara ala na a kete carrés wala a boules.

en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.
sg: Robert Hooke, wa gingo nda zo na a yama ti mara ti anglais, a ba a kete ye na ya ti liege na microscope.

en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells
sg: Ala kpa a kubu. Lo yeke kozo zo so a ba a kete tere so a kui.

en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.
sg: A ye na ala so a bongbi alinbi ti ga ambeni so a yeke bian pepe.

en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.
sg: Azote tongana gaz a yeke ka na tongana azote liquide. Ngu ayeke kono mingi na mbage molecules ayeke la kue oko.

en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
sg: Ngu ayeke mbeni tapande. Bongbi ngo ti ngu a bongbi atome use hydrogene na mbeni atome oxygene.

en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.
sg: Ala yeke na molecule oko, so ayeke mbeni gaz, mbeni liquide wala solide.

en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.
sg: Ahon kue tere ti lo a bian, nda ti tere ti lo a ngba lakue.

en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.
sg: Ngoi ayeke mbeni ye so anguru e na a ndu ye kue so i yeke sara, na mbange ayeke ngangu ti hinga.

en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.
sg: Awahingango ndo na ndo tene ti nzapa la si a manda ye na ndo ti ngoi, senda ndara na senda ye kozo na ya ti a gba ti ngu.

en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.
sg: E duti na ngoi tongana mbni a ye so ayeke hon na a ga na fini ni na ayeke da.

en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.
sg: Ngoi ayeke nga mbeni kode ti ba ya ti ningango(ninga) ti a ye so ayeke ga.

en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.
sg: Ala lingbi ti fa nga ngoi so a hon ti ba mbeni ye so ayeke si lakue. Mbeni ye so a yeke cyclique ayeke ye so a leke ndoni nga lakue lakue.

en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.
sg: A kambuta ti fade so a sara na kua ti sara ngo a limo.

en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.
sg: Asarango nguombi ngangu alingbi ti lekere na ndo a kambuta, si a pika ngo ngombi so a yeke lekere ti sara na kusala na ya ti a da limo.

en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.
sg: Mozoko ayeke bata ni na lege ti mungo maboko ti a kambuta so ayeke ngangu ti tene a lekere lego ni.

en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.
sg: A yo mingi, na ngungbangbo 19 na 20, e yeda e tene a kozo a zo ti Nouvelle-Zélande a yeke a Maoris, so a gui a kota ndeke so a iri ala moas.

en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.
sg: Fango ye a gue da ti zia mbeni gbu ngo li so a zo ti maori a gu na Polynésie na ya ti kota ngu na a mu Nouvella-Zelande na a Morior, a sara mbeni ndo kua ti fango yaka.

en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.
sg: Atâa, afini fango ye atene azo ti Moriori ayeke kundu oko ti Maoris ti continent so ague duti na Nouvelle -Zelande na mbage ti zûa ti Chatham, ti ùai ùbei ye nde nde ti ala nga na siriri.

en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.
sg: Ayeke na mara ti azo na ndo ti azua ti Chatham, ayeke Maoris so ague na Nouvelle-Zélande.

en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out
sg: Ala iri ala-mveni Moriori na mbeni escarmouches nga na na hunzingo ni, azo ti Moriori afâ ala.

en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.
sg: Gba ti a zo asara kpale longo gbati angugbangbo a mu maboko na e ti hinga ngangu ti e nga na ye so e ye ni ti fa na bê ti e kue akpale nga na bi mbeni ye na sese.

en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.
sg: Mango azo angba ti fa lisoro ti ala mveni, ti asewa nga na ti ndokua ti kurara, e wara pendere nduru bango le ti ngbere ye nga na ti mbeni azo so afa azo sarango tiala ti ga na nzoni ye wala ti sioni mara ye nde nde ti kundu ti zo ni.

en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.
sg: Atâa, hingango lisoro ti lo ahunda mandango ti mara ye nde nde ti lo pepe, amu lege na azo ti hhinga ala na ndo wa na lisoro ti kundu ni.

en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.
sg: Ti ba amaingo ti aye nga na za na li ti ala aye so ague na lege ni pepe, azo ngana kubdu ti azo abongbi ala ke hinga anengo ngangu , kua nga na a force motrice ti kundu ti azo ni.

en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.
sg: Na aye so, fango aye so ahon kozo tongana tapande ti dutingo ti sarango ye ti buze nga na ti amaingo ti ye amu lege na azo ti zi lege na afin maingo nga na fini lege ti danzapa ti kodoro.

en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.
sg: A mara lisoro ti maingo ni abi mbeto ti bïängbï, fango a pendere bango ye ti bïängbï ti gigi ti peko ni.

en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.
sg: A schémas ti gbu ngo li so a gue na legue oko a yeke kodekua ti zärängö a kpälë so a bumbi a bibê ndengue na ndengue tene ti wara ngo ndâkpälë.

en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.
sg: Bogoma ti yingo sê so a yeke loro, boroli, nsêmbîrîmbîrî na hïngängö a ye, sara ngo a kode yeke da, na rokôto ngo a sango.

en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.
sg: Nenêe-tënë ti mara bibê so a yéké so djoni na kîri-hûnda a yéké gî ôko. Ala gbu ke gbu li ti ala gui na kîri-hûnda ussê, so a yéké djoni ni wala sioni ni.

en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.
sg: Mara ti bibê so a bumbi na Âmbênî sêndâyê wala lêgë ti sara ngo ye na legue ni.

en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.
sg: A zo so a yeke na mara ti bibê so a yeke na bibê tî mbîrîmbîrî, ala ke na ngangou ti bata a schémas, ti wara pekô ti a kpale na ti sâra kua na ndo ti a kêtê gizamäa ti sêndâyê.

en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.
sg: Azo ala yeke ayo mara anyama so ayeke na ndara ti diko na gbungbo li ti ti ambeni azo nde.

en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.
sg: So atene e pe ti ba aye so mbeni azo aba ayo, ala ye ti sara, ama na bê, ahinga wala aye ni.

en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.
sg: Na popo ti andara, mango aye zo nde aye ti sara ayeke ngangu. Amu lege na e ti zia mbeni mango tere ti sarango ti physique pepe.

en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.
sg: Tapande, tonga mo ba azo lo fa vitre ti kutukutu, ake fa tatene lo ye ti nzi kutukutu ti zo ti wande ni.

en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.
sg: E du a ti sara tene nde tongana lo girisa kerere ti kutukutu ti lo nga ayeke kutukutu ti lomveni lo tara ti li na yani na nzingo ye.

en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).
sg: Gündâ ti IRM ayeke mbeni phenomene physique so a iri résonnance magnétoque nucléaire (RMN), so aba gigi na angu 1930 na Felix Bloch (lo sara kua na Kota dambeti ti Stanford) nga na Edward Purcell ( ti Kota dambeti ti Harvard).

en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.
sg: Na mango go ni, champ magnétique nga na onde ti dafononon aga na atome so afa ake kete ago ti dafononon.

en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.
sg: Na ngu 1970, Raymond Damadian, wanganga nga na wasenda ye ti gingo gingo, a ba sarango ti imagerie nalondo na go ti magnétique tongana gbakuru ti gingo kobela.

en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.
sg: Na peko ti angu osio, amu brevet, so ayeke kozo brevet na dunia amu na kusara ti IRM.

en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.
sg: Na ngu 1977, Waganga Damadian lo hunzi lekengo ti kozo scanner ti IRM "tere kue", lo iri ni "Indomtable".

en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.
sg: Vungango asango ti asynchrone amu ngbonga ti gbu li nga na kiri tene na amba.

en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.
sg: Amu lege na awamandango mbeti ti sara kua na ngbonga ti ala nga na hinga ngonga ti asango ti mandango mbeti.

en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)
sg: Ahon ye kue, akangango lege ayeke ti kete ngoi na warango angbonga ti kua so alingbi. (Bremer, 1998)

en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.
sg: Sarango kue na Internet nga na World Wide Web amu lege na awamandango mbeti ti li na asango na ngoi kue.

en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.
sg: Awamandango mbeti ala pe ti fa ahunda na awafango mbeti ngoi kue ti lango nga na ku hio kiringo tene, na palaze ti ku gi bongbi ti le na le ti peko.

en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.
sg: Approche postmoderne ti mandango ye afa ayamba so ayeke na lenge ni. Mbeni nzoni lege ti mandango ye ayeke da pepe.

en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.
sg: Tatene, mbeni ye oko ti manda ni ayeke da pepe. Mandango ye ayeke mu ndo na hhhingango-ndo na popoti a wamandango mbeti nga na andara ala fa ni.

en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.
sg: Hingango-ndo ti e ti laso na akwasînga ti television kue aba mandango ye nga na ti sara mo-mveni, vungango asanga, afa aye ni so.

en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.
sg: Agbati azo na popo ti e le duti ti ba mbeni kwasînga ti television so avunga asango na e ti lege wala hingango-ndo so e yeke bongbi tere pepe wala esara ye kue pepe na ndo ti ahingango ye ni.

en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.
sg: E pe ti ba kutukutu ye kue apëe, leke du ti ngu na yaka ti e, guengo gene na Pérou ti ba ngere mbeni ye agba na peko ti bira wala sara aye ti pendere na ti mba ti e.

en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.
sg: Ndäli tî cable ague na gbe ti ngu a iri fible optique ti na Poto nga na satellite ti kota dafononon, Groenland ayeke connecté na 93% ti azo ala ke na Internet.

en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.
sg: Da ti lango ti mo wala Azo zo ayamba mo (tongana mo lango na da ti zo wala da ti lango) alake duti na wifi wala orninateur asara na internet, nga ando kue ayeke na cybercafé wala ndo ti wifi ti azo kue.

en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.
sg: Tongana e ba ye so e fa na nduzu, azo ti Amerika ala ye da tene ti “Eskimo”, azo so ala yeke azo ti Etats Unis pepe ala ba nga tene ni ake sioni. Azo ti arctique, mingi ala so si aduti na Canada.

en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.
sg: Tongana mo ma tene ti azo ti Groenlad, azo ti wande fade ala du a ti tene atene so pepe.

en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.
sg: Azo so si a du ala na sese ti Groeland a iri ala mveni Inuit na Canada nga na Kalaalled (gbati ni ake Kalaallit), zo ti Groeland , na sese ti Groeland.

en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."
sg: Fango azo nga na sarango sioni na awande ahon ye kue ayeke da pepe na Groenland. Atâa na ndo ti agbata, "ando ti kpale" ayeke da pepe.

en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.
sg: Dê a pe ti duti gi oko a kpale so azo so aleke tere ti ala nzoni pepe ala pe ti wara.

en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.
sg: Tongana mo gue na ndo ti Groenland na ngoi ti de (da asara mingi tongant mo gue na mbage ti banga) yake nzoni ti guengo na abongo ti ndowa mingi.

en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.
sg: A yongoro alango ti été a pe ti ga na akpale ti lango nga na kpale ti kobela kue.

en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.
sg: Na ngoi ti été, ala sâra hânge kue na sioni angoungou. Atâa ala mu kobele oko pepe, ala pe ti siriri ti mo.

en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.
sg: Atâa buze ti San Francisco akanga na aye so lo yeke ndo ti tourisme so dunia kue ahinga, buze ti lo ayeke mara nde nde.

en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.
sg: Andokua tu gingo kua ayeke mingi akusara ti ala, govoroma, mama nginza, buze nga na tourisme.

en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.
sg: Bango ti lo na mozoko, alimo, dikongo mbeti, mara aye nde ti azo amu le ge azo ti hinga gbata nga monument na dunia kue.

en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.
sg: San Francisco aleke kota ando ti a touriste nga na gbati ada ti lango, ada ti tengo kobe nga na Kota da ti congrès kozo Pendere so ahon ye kue.

en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.
sg: San Francisco ayeke oko ti pendere ando ti kodoro ndali ti kobe ti Asie: Ti Corée, Thaïlande, Indien nga na ti Japon.

en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.
sg: Guengo na Walt Disney world ayeke mara tambula ti azo ti nzapa ti gbati asewa ti Amerika.

en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.
sg: Guengo gene "type" atene mu lapara ti aéroport ti popokodoro ti Orlando, mu kara ti guengo na da ti lango ti Disney, ti sara layenga oko ti ngba gi na Disney nga na kiri na kodoro.

en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".
sg: Ayeke na agbati mara ye nde nde, me ayeke gi aye so azo atene tongana ala tene "Gue na Sidney World".

en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.
sg: Agbati a billet aka ni na lege ti internet na sites ti kango ye tongana eBay wala Craigslist ayeke a billets ti parc so ayeke na gnati alango mo pe ti gue ka ni.

en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.
sg: Tongana ayeke kusara ti lakue lakue, Disney akanga lege ti lo: mo pe ti wara a billet pepe.

en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.
sg: Tongana mo ye ti lango na gigi na ndo ti Kota Canyon alingbi na mo ti wara mbeti ti mungo lege ti guengo na kete agbata ti kodoro.

en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.
sg: Ambeti ti batango canyon ake gi kete nga na ala yeke wara ya ni lango 1 ti nzè ni, â nzè osio kozô nzè ahundi.

en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.
sg: Ti tene nduru, mbeti ti mungo lege ti guengo na kete agbata ti kodoro so amu na lango kue ti lingo na yati nze ti Belawou ake ba ndo na lango ti 1 na nze ti Gnyenye.

en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.
sg: Ndo so azo a hinga mingi, a kpa Bright Angel Campground so ayeke nduru na Phantom Ranch, atondani na azo na lege ti ahundango ndo so ala yeke wara kozo lango so si ala zi lege na azo ti bata aplaze ti ala.

en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.
sg: Ayeke gi na kete a wungo ti hundango mbeti ti mungo lege ala ape ti mu ndali ti hundango ye so a iri ndo kozo pepe na ya ti bango mungo mbeni ye na zo so a ga kozo.

en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.
sg: Li na Afrika ti australe na kutukutu ayeke pendere lege ahon ti ba nzerengo tia gbakodoro anga na ti gue na ando so ayeke a lege ti touriste pepe.

en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.
sg: Ape ti sara ya ni na nzoni kutukutu ti za da na yati sarango ange kue mbeni lekengo ye, me kutukutu ti 4x4 ayeke nzoni ahon nga na agbati ando zo ape ti li da gi na 4 x 4 guengo na loro.

en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.
sg: Ala zia na bê ti ala, na ngoi ti leke sarango mbeni ye atâa so Africka ti australe ayeke na siriri, tangani akodor kue ayeke na ni pepe.

en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.
sg: ahunda nga na ngere ti via ayeke nde na kodoro oko oko nga na ayeke ngangu na kodoro so mo londo da.

en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.
sg: Kodoro oko oko ayeke na andi ti lo hunda akungba ti nye mo pe to yo na kutukutu ti mo ti mu na mo maboko tongana mbeni ye ti kpalé asi.

en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.
sg: Victoria Falls ayeke gbata ti mbage tô ti Zimbabwe, na mbange nde ti yanga ti kodoro so akangbi Livingstone, Zambie nga na nduru na Botswana.

en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.
sg: Gbata ayeke nduru na atingo ti ngun nga na ayeke kozo ndo azo aye ti ba mingi, me ndo ti atouriste azo ahinga ayeke mu legeoko na azo ti gingo fini aye nga na a touriste gbati gingo tongana ala sara agbati lango.

en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.
sg: Ngoï tî ngûnzapä (Nabandourou asi na mbango), ngu ayeke ga mingi ahon nga na tingo ti ngu ayeke ga pendere.

en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.
sg: Ala hinga nzoni bpngp ti ala ayeke wara ngu tonganan ala fa gbägbära wala tongana ala tambula na kete alege ayeke nduru na titingo ti ngu.

en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!
sg: Na mbage nde, ayeke tatene ndali ti gnati ngu ahon asara si bango ti tingo ti angu ti ala ayeke kanga na ngu kue.

en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.
sg: Da ti kui ti Toutankhamon (KV62). KV62 ayeke da ti kui na popo ti a ada ti kui ti hoto so azo kue ahinga, Théatre ti bango ye ti fini Howoard Carter asara na 1922 ti da ti kui ti gbia a gnba nzoni.

en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.
sg: Ti ba atangani da ti lungo kua ti gbia, atâa, da ti kûa ti Toutankhamon ahunda ti gue ba ani si, ayeke kete ahon nga na anzoroko a zia da ayeke mingi pepe.

en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.
sg: Zo kue aye ti ba aye so angba na kpalé so aga na momie na ngoi ti tara ti zi sandüku ayeke son bê ti lo ndali ti gi li nga na pâmbotï ti lo ayeke da.

en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.
sg: Pendere a mosoro da ti kui ayeke da pepe, me ala gboto ani na musée ti azo ti Egypte na Caire.

en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.
sg: Agene ayeke na akete ngbonga ayeke nzoni na ala si ala gue ti hu tere ti ala na mbege nde.

en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.
sg: Phnom Krom, ndo na yongoro ti km 12 na mbage ti mbongo-dô ti Siem Reap. Da ti nzapa so na nduzu aleke ya ni na ngugbangbo 9, lani Yasovarman ayeke gbia.

en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.
sg: Voko sende ti da ti nzapa nga na bango le na ndo ti kötä ngû ti Tonlé Sap ahunga ti ko na ndo ti hoto.

en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.
sg: Guengo gene ti site ape ti bongbi na tambula na mangboko guengo na kötä ngû.

en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.
sg: Col ti Angkor ayeke ngangu ti li nai da ti nzapa, Ni lâa ala girisa ti ga na passeport ti ala pepe tongana ala mu lege ti gue na Tonlé Sap.

en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.
sg: Jérusalem ayeke kodoro sese nga na kota gbata ahon ti Israël, atâa mbeni tangani akodoro nga na Bendo ti Gigi ahinga lo tongana kodoro sese ti Israël pepe.

en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.
sg: Ngere gbata ti ahoto ti Judée ayeke na pendere mbai so ague na ndonti gbati akûtu ti angu.

en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.
sg: Gbata ni ayeke wamokondö ndali ti danzapa monoteiste ota - judaïsme, christianismenga na islam, nga na ayeke ndo ti bê ingo, ti nzapa nga na mara aye nde nde.

en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.
sg: Ndani ti so gbata ayeke kota ye ti nzapa, nga na mingi gbati a sites ngbere gbata ni, Jérusalem ayeke oko na popo tia ndo so abongbi gbati a touriste na Israël.

en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.
sg: Jérusalem ayeke na pendere a sites ti touriste, archéologiques nga na ti mara aye nde nde, na kota dabuze, ada ti yongo kâwa nga na ada ti tengo kobe ayeke na go ti azo nga na gbati azo.

en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.
sg: Euquateur ahunda azo ti kodoro ti Cuba kue awara mbeti ti guengo ni kozo ala li na Equateur na lege ti aéroport ti popokodoro wala ando ti yanga ti kodoro akangbi na kodoro nde.

en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.
sg: Mbeti ti so adu a ti wara hingango ti bungbi ti agbenyon gbia ti Equateur so aba aye ti kodoro wande nga na mu nëngö andia ni so.

en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.
sg: Andia ni akpe ti mu lge na gabt ti azo ti li na popo ti a us akodoro.

en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.
sg: Azo ti Cuba so ayeke na ngû-ngunzä carte ti Amerika adu a ti gue na Consulat ti Equateur ti wara mbeni tene azia lege na andia ni so.

en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.
sg: Passeport ti mo adu a ti wara nzoni ngu atâa angu 6 na peko ti alango ti guengo gene ti mo.Billet ti mo ti guengo wala ti kiringo ayeke hunda ani ti fa lango oke mo yeke sara ni.

en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.
sg: Ngere ti atambula ti kundu ti gbati azo ayeke kete, ni la tongana mo gue mo oko wala gi na mba ti mo oko, haa ti baa tere na a mbeni azo nde nga na ala gongbi tere teti kundu oko ti azo osio wala omene ti wara pendere ngere na zo oko oko.

en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.
sg: Ahon kue, yeni a du ti gbu li ti mo pepe, ndâli tî atourist mingi a tiri ti li na yati akutukutu.

en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.
sg: Ayeke fadeso lege ti tene vene na azo ti tene a za na li ti ala ye ti futa gbati a nginza.

en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.
sg: Guengo na gbe banga ti Machu Picchu ayeke yongoro hoto, so azo mu foto mingi.

en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.
sg: Aga kete kpale londongo na gbeni, nga na ngangu kete ti kongo hoto, me agbati azo ti sêterê ape ti kö yati hoto na angbonga 45 senge.

en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.
sg: A zia da atene so azo ake tambula na ndo ni na lege kue, nga na lege so ayeke ngangu, a cables ti acier ni amu titene maboko na azo ti ti pepe.

en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.
sg: Na peko ti tene tanso, ala pe ti bi wungo tere ti ala nga na ala sara ânge na ndo so ayeke na nduzu, mingi tongana ala yeke na ngu, so ape ti ga hio kota kpalé.

en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.
sg: Kete grotte ayeke na yanga ti hoto so mo du a ti fa ni, ayeke na nduzu pepe akanga ya ni.

en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.
sg: Bango asite nga na gigi ti Galapagos ayeke nzoni na mangboko, tongana ye so Charles Darwin asara na ngu 1835.

en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.
sg: Amangboko ahon 60 a gue na angu ti Galapagos - gongbi a wungo ti agene longo 8 a si 100.

en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).
sg: Gbati azo a bata ngende ti ala nzoni kozo (ndali ti azo ayeke gbani na amangboko na ngoi so).

en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.
sg: Hinga nzoni zo so a bata ngende ayeke Zo ti ndara ti Galapago so a hinga gbati aye ndali ti mara ti amangboko so a gue ka.

en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.
sg: So ayeke faa ti tene aye so mo ye ni nga na/wala ye so mo ye pepe ague legeoko na mangboko alingbi na mo na mbage ti ala.

en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.
sg: Kozo gango ti azo ti Espagne na ngûngbangbo 16, mbage banga ti Chili ayeke na sese ti ngangu ti Inca, andaa fade abasenzi ti Araucaniens (Mapuche) ala gba lango na bê nga na mbongo ti Chili.

en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.
sg: Azo ti Mapuche ayeke oko na popo ti akundu ti azo ti Amerika ti bansenzi so ayeke yamba kue, so ayeke na sese ti ngangu ti hispanophone gi na peko a yamba ti Chili

en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.
sg: Atâa Chili adiko yamba ti lo na ngu 1810 (na popo ti atiringo bira ti Napoléo so a sara si kodoro ti Espagne angba na govoroma ti bê pepe na yati kete angu), benda na ndo ti azo ti Espagne a ga gi na ngu 1818.

en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti
sg: Kodoro ti Republique dominicaine ( Na yanga ti Espagne : República Dominicana) ayeke oko na popo ti akodoro ti Caraïbe a mu ndambo ndo na mbage ti Este ti Zua ti Hispagnola, akangbi na Kodoro ti Haïti.

en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.
sg: Na ndoni mbutu sese so avuru na ahoto, kodoro ayeke na a ngbere gbata ti Pötö ti kodoro ti Amerika, ayeke fadeso mbage ti Saint-Domingue.

en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.
sg: Azo ti Tainos nga na ti Caraibe ala lango kozo na yati zua ni so. Azo ti Caraibe ala yeke azo so a tene yanga ti Arawakan so si a ga na yati sese ngu 10.000 kozo gangon ti Jesus Christ.

en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors
sg: Na yati kete angu ahon na peko ti gangon ti azo ti gingo gingon ti Poto, azo ti Tainos a fa ala na aturugu ti bira ti Espagne.

en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.
sg: Azo ti tiringo bira ti Espagne alango na Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) na ngu 1492 nga na 1498 azo ti tiringo bira ti Epagne ala fa azo 100 000 ti Tainos.

en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.
sg: Jardin de la Union. Ndo ni so a ba gigi tongana atrium ti da ti awali boi ti nzampa ti ngûngbangbo 17, ayeke da ti Nzapa ti San Diego oko so azo angba na gigi

en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.
sg: A sara fadeso tongana, ndo ti bê nga na a wara gi gbati aye ti sara ni, lango nga na bi.

en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.
sg: Mbeni agbati da ti tengo kobe ayeke na mbage ti a yaka, nga na bêkombïte nga na lakui, a pe ti baa senge adodo ti azo londo na a bê ti gazebo.

en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.
sg: Callejon del Beso (Lege ti warango tere ti wali nga na ti koli). Ada use ayeke na mbage nde nde na yongoro ti centimetre 69 ayeke na ngbêre mbai ti ndoye.

en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.
sg: Tongana mo mu gi kete nginzan amolenge a ke tene na mo a mbai.

en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.
sg: Gueno gene na Zua ti Bowen ayeke lango oko wala yenga oko na yati kayak, tambula, guengo na ndo de buze, ada ti tengo kobe nga na ye so ahon mingi.

en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.
sg: A kundu ti azo so ayeke nde ayeke na Howe Sound, gi na mbage ti Vancouver, nga na zo a pe ti li ka na lege ti amangboko a gue ka lakue lakue londo na Zua ti Granville, na bê ti Vancouver.

en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.
sg: Azo zo so aye angia ti gigi, mbeni tambula na ndo ti lege ti Sea to Sky a yeke da.

en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.
sg: Whistler (so ayeke na ngbonga oko nga na ndambo ti a lege ti Vancouver) ngere ti lo ayeke ngangu minngi azo ahinga ni ndali ti Angia ti olympiques ti ngoi ti de ti ngu 2010.

en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.
sg: Na hiver, za si ala wara pendere lege ti sarango ski na Amerika ti Banga nga na na été, ala tambula na gbâzâbängâ ti hoto alingbi na ni.

en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.
sg: A mbeti ti mungo lele ti gue guengo azo a du ti wara ni kozo. Ala du a ti xara a mbeti ti mungo lege ndali ti sara lango oko na Sirena.

en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.
sg: Sirena ayeke station azo ti fango yaka oko so amundo ti lango na kete ada nga na kobe ti wa nga na camping. San Pedrillo nga na Los Patos a mu gi camping senge ayeke na kobe da pepe.

en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards
sg: Zo a pe ti wara mbeti ti mungo lege ti parc hio na ndo ti Ranget Station na mbage ti Puerto Jimenez, me ala ye da carte ti credit pepe.

en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.
sg: Ndokua ti kusara ti parc (MINAE) a mu mbeti ti mungo lege ti li na yati parc ahon nze oko kozo gangao ti zo pepe.

en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.
sg: CafeNet El Sol asara kusara ti batango ye na ngere ti 30$ ti Etat Unis, wala 10$ ti wara mbeti ti höngo senge ti lango oko; ba aye so na mbeti ti ala a iri Corvado.

en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.
sg: Azua ti Cook ayeke kodoro so agongbi na Nouvelle-Zélande, ayeke na ndo ti Polynésie, na bê ti ngu ingo ti pacifique ti mbongo.

en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.
sg: Ayeke agongbi ti azua 15 ayeke yongoro ti ngüdango 2,2 km2 ti ngu ingo.

en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".
sg: Na yati senge a ngbonga so akpa ti Hawai, azua ayeke ataa tongana "Hawaii down under".

en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.
sg: Atâa ayeke kete ahon, a fa na ambeni agene ti Hawaï so ngu ti ala ahon kozo statii ti Letâa zi akota da ti lango ti atouriste nga na maingo nde nde.

en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.
sg: Azua ti Cook ayeke na angata pepe me ayeke agongbi ti azua 15 nde nde. So akono ayeke Rarotonga nga na Aitutaki.

en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.
sg: Na ndo ti akodoro so amaï laso, mungo a pendere ndo ti lango ti nginza na a gene ayeke fango mara ti aye so kue ayeke pendere mingi.

en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.
sg: Na yati a ando ti lango ti nginza, ando ti lango a fa mingi a pendere ti ala na lege use: gbogbo nga na chaillé.

en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.
sg: Andâa, na pendere ti ando ti lango ni, mo yeke wara pendere gbogbo ti nginza, atâa courte pointe aleke na maboko wala gbere gbogbo ni.

en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.
sg: Chaillé a pe ti duti anzere kugbe ti kassa ti tengo ye ti gbakodoro wala kobe so gnene a ye ni.

en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.
sg: Ndo ti kua ape ti duti ngere da so ayeke na mbeni lisoro na ngere meuble, ando so ala bata pendere nga na piscine oko.

en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.
sg: lingo na kutukutu ti mo-veni nga na guengo yongo gene ayeke duti nzoni mingi ndali ti mo teti mo yeke gue gi senge.

en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.
sg: Tongana mo yo kutukutu ti mo-veni mo yeke hinga kpale ti lo, ayeke du da tanso pepe na akota ahon kutukunu.

en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.
sg: Za da ndo ti zo wala na mbeni gbata azo ayeke za sioni le ti ala na ndo ti mo.

en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".
sg: Ahon kue, tambela na kutukutu ti mo mveni ayeke pendere lege ti gue gene ti lege me mo pe ti gue "camping" pepe na ni.

en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.
sg: Mo pe ti sara camping na kutukutu ti mo tongana ye ni akono, tongana SUV, berline wala break so ayeke na angende alango.

en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.
sg: Ambeni ando ti lango ayeke na héritage ti âge d'or ti lege ti kutukutu ti wên ti vapeur nga na paquebots, kozo Use Bira ti Dunia, na angungbangbo 19 wala tondani na angungbangbo 20.

en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.
sg: Ando ti lango ni so ayeke ndo so azo ti nginza nga na azo ahinga ala mingi alango da, nga na a mu pendere kobe nga na gigi ti bi.

en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.
sg: Sarango ye na angbere kungba, sarango ye na agbâkûrû ti laso pepe nga na sarango ye kue gi na ngbere lekengo ye ayeke lege so ala fa kua ti ala.

en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.
sg: Andaa ayeke ndo ti azo, agbia ti kodoro nga na mbeni Kota azo a gue gene ka.

en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.
sg: Gene so ayeke na gbati nginza lo pe ti mu gene ti tambula na dunia kue, nga na fa yani na ndambo alango na ndo ti gbati ando ti lango.

en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.
sg: Réseau ti bïängbï ti ando ti lango ayeke agonbgi so aza palaze oko agene na azo ti agnata so ala ye ti gue gene.

en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.
sg: Ti li na yati réseau ni, mo du ati su mbeni mbeti na lege ti internet; atâa mbeni aréseau ayeke mu wala ayeke hunda si mo ba nzoni si.

en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.
sg: Mo yeke wara iri ti ando ti lango na lege ti mbeti nga na/ wala na internet, atâa na iri ti ando nga na atene ti mbeni agene.

en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.
sg: Couchsurfing a ba gigi na nze ti Gnyegnye ngu 2004 na peko so azo ti informatique Casey Fenton lo wara ndali ti mo ngere kete gene ti Islande me lo wara ndo ti lango da kä pepe

en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.
sg: Lotoka mbeti na lege ti internet na awamandango mbeti ti kota dambeti ti kodoro nga na lo wara gbati ando ti lango senge.

en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.
sg: Ando ti lango ayeke ti amaseka - zo ti lango ka ayeke na ngu balë ûse - me ala pe ti wara agene so ngu ti ala ahon .

en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.
sg: Asewa so ayeke na amolenge aye ke da mingi pepe, me mbeni ando ti lango a mu lege na ala ti lango na ndo ti ada ti azo ni.

en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.
sg: Gbata ti Pékin na Chine ayeke duti gbata so asoro ndali ti Angia ti Olympique ti hiver na ngu 2022, asara si aduti kozo gbata so agongbi legeoko a Ngia ti Olympique ti été nga na ti hiver

en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.
sg: Beijing ayeke yamba amatanga ti zingo nga na kangango nga na amandako ti glace na da ti ngia.

en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.
sg: Mbani amandako ti ski ayeke mu ndo na ndo ti sarango ski ti Taizicheng na Zhangjiakou, a yo kilometre 220 (140 miles) ti Pékin.

en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.
sg: Ada Nzapa kue ayeke na matanga ti ngu, atondani na hunzingo nze ti nabandourou ti si ndambo ti bêlawou, so abïän ndali ti calendrier ti ngu ti da Nzapa oko oko.

en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.
sg: Amatanga ti da tî Nzapä mingi asara ni ndali ti matânga tî düngö ti da tî Nzapä wala matânga tî düngö ti wamokondo ti gbia wala mbeni kota matanga agongbi na da tî Nzapä.

en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.
sg: Amatanga ayeke anzere mingi ti ba amatanga ti da tî Nzapä ti Kera, nga na sigingo ti adoli na anzoroko, kundu ti da ti Nzapa so hê bîâ nga na mbeni matanga angba.

en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.
sg: Fango ye ti ndo Gigi (mingi a iri ni Exposition Universelle, wala gi senge Expo) ayeke kota matanga ti popokodoro ti arts wala asêndâyê.

en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.
sg: Akodoro so abongbi na mbeni matanga ala fa aye ti sara ngia nga na mu ndara na apavillon ti akodoro ti fa na le ti azo kue akpalé ti dunia nga na mara ye nde nde nga na mbai ti kodoro.

en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.
sg: Fango aye ti horticole ti popokodoro na le ti azo kue ayeke ayê sô nde nde afa akongö, ayaka ti kongö nga na aye kue a ka mara ti akongö.

en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.
sg: Atâa atene ayeke awara ndo na ya ti ngu oko lakue lakue (awara ndo na akodoro nde nde), na sarango ye ni so, ayeke awara ndo ni pepe.

en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.
sg: Amatanga so ayeke ninga londo anze ota ti si na anze omënë nga na awara ndo na asite yongoro ti ahectare 50.

en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.
sg: Ayeke na amara ti alimo nde nde so azo asara na ya ni na angu ahon. Limo ti mm 35 (négatif mm 36x24) ayeke ye so azo ahinga mingi.

en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.
sg: Mo pe leke ya ni senge tongana mo yeke na ani pepe nga na sarango ti lo akpa reflex ti numérique ti laso.

en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.
sg: Ambeni kete agbakuru ti foto ti argentique asara na format ti cm 6 x 6, ahon négatif mm 56 x 56.

en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).
sg: Amu nzoni bango ye ahon Fâni ota aye ti negatif mm 35 (mm2 3136 nga na 864).

en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.
sg: Guengo na yaka ayeke mbeni ye ake nganu na le ti a azo ti mungo foto nga na ahunda ala ti duti na päsä, bêku, ndara ti kua nga na nzoni gbakuru.

en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.
sg: Mungo foto ti anyama ayeke aye so mo du a ti sara na bê ti mo mveni, me ahon ye kue mungo foto, a ye ti fa pendere foto akanga sâke ôko ti atene biani.

en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.
sg: Mungo foto ti anyama ahunda mingi yongoro téléobjectif, atâa aye so aba hurungo ti andeke wala kete kete ayeti ayeke hunda mbeni agbakuru nde.

en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.
sg: Anyama mingi ti yaka a pe ti wara ala nga na a parc akëin azo a mu foto ti anyama ndali ti buze.

en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.
sg: Anyama so alango na gigi a pe ti duti na mbeto wala sara sioni na azo. Ndo ni ape ti wara de, ndo wa wala ape ti sara sioni na azo.

en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.
sg: Dunia kue ayeke na ahon 5000 ayanga nde nde, nga na ahon bale use na angugbango 50 ti azo atene ayanga nï wala ahon.

en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.
sg: Atene so asu ya nî ayeke ngangu pepe ti manda nî nga atene zo atene na yenga kue. Ayeke tatene biani teti adno ti lango, so ayeke nganu ti tene na ndo ni na nzoni lege ni.

en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.
sg: Gbati akodoro kue atene yanga ti anglais, nga na ahon kue, ala ke ba kete hingango ye mingi na popo ti amaseka.

en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.
sg: Ala gbu li ti ala, tongana ala ye azo ti Mancunie, ti Boston, ti Jamaïque nga na ti Sydnay ala duti na mêza oko ti te kobe na a da ti tengo kobe ti Toronto.

en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.
sg: Anzere na ala ti ma lisoro ti kodoro ti dungo ti ala, atene na lege ti ala nde nde nga na yanga ti kodoro.

en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.
sg: Vongo kobe na kota da tî büzë ayeke ahon ye kue lege ti warango ye kue ti tengo ni na kete nginza. Mo yeke to ni pepe, atâa zo ape ti sörö gi kobe so ala to awe.

en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.
sg: Ahon kue kota da tî büzë awara gbati a mara ti kobe so ala to awe. Ambeni amu four ti micro-ondes wala ambeni alege ti za kobe wâ.

en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.
sg: Na yati mbeni kodoro wala mara ti da tî büzë, ayeke na da ti tengo kobe so akono pepe nga na ngere ti lo ayeke na sese.

en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.
sg: Leke tere ti mo nga na yo kopi ti mbeti ti batango tere ti mo nga na asinga ti zo ti mungo mbeti ti batango tere ti mo.

en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.
sg: A du a ti fa mail ti zo ti mungo mbeti ti batango tere ti mo nga na asinga ti popokodoro ti wara wängö/mbeti ti mungo lele nga na hundango ye.

en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").
sg: Ala wara mbeni kopi nde na akungba ti ala nga na na internet (ala tonka mbeti na interne na ala mveni nga na mbeti aza, wala abata ni na "cloud").

en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).
sg: Tongana mo gue gene na a ordinateur ti yongo ni wala tablette, bata kopi oko na mémoire ti lo wala na disque ti lo (mo pe ti diko atâa mo ke na internet pepe).

en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.
sg: Ala mu akopi ti poroso kue/singa na amba ti ala ti guengo gene nga a ita wala amba tongana kiri yanga da ti mu ala maboko.

en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.
sg: Nyama ti elan (so azo ahinga na iri ti wapiti) ayeke sara sioni pepe me lo ke tiri ti bata tere ti lo tongana lo ba mbeni ye ti sioni na tere ti lo.
