en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.
sg: Tongana azo a ba Elan anyama so ape ti sara sioni pepe, ala pe ti gue nduru nga wara kota kpalé ni.

en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.
sg: Yo asämba ti alcool gi kete. Alcool ason azo kue na lege nde nde, na hingango ndo so mo pe hunzi to yongo ni ayeke ngangu mingi.

en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.
sg: A pasi so aga na tere ti mo ndali ti yongo a samba mingi a pe ti ga na kpalé foie nga na mo ga wazïbä nga kûa. Kpalé ni ayeke duti ngangu na ngoi ti yongo alcool so Letaa amu lege ti kango ya ni pepe.

en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.
sg: Asamba so Letaa a mu lege ti ka pepe ape duti na mbeni aye ti sioni, tongana methano, so pe ti wara zïbä walakûa atâa mo yo gi kete ya ni.

en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.
sg: Atatärä lë ape ti duti na kete ngere na kodoro wande, mingi na akodoro ti kete nginza ndo afuta azo gi na kete nginza tongana ala sara mbeni kwa.

en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.
sg: Ala sara examen ti le na yanga da, mingi tongana ndokua ti batango tere ake futa ya ni, nga na mo ga na ordonnance mo ke za da na ndo nde.

en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.
sg: Atatärä lë so ngere ti ala ayeke ngangu na ndo ni so ape ti duti na kpalé pepe; ambeni ape ti duti so azo asara nzoni apëe, nga na anzoni so alondo na kodoro wande ngere ti ala ni ayeke ngangu ahon ti so aka na kodoro.

en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.
sg: Café ayeke ambeni aye aka mingi na dunia, nga na ala yeke wara mbeni mara aye na gbakodoro ti ala.

en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.
sg: Atâa, gbati alege ti yongo café ayeke da na dunia azo a du a ti tara ni.

en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.
sg: Canyoning (wala : canyoneering) ayeke ti gue na gündâ ti canyon, so ayeke wala a ole, wala na ngu da.

en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).
sg: Canyoning agonbgi mara ye kue ti sarango gnia na ya ti ngu, gue na nduzu nga na ti na ngu, me ahunda kete lekengo tere wala dutingo na nganu tere kozo ti tondani sara ni (aba gue na nduzu, li na yani ngu wala ski ti alpen tapande).

en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.
sg: Tambula ayeke kusara ti gigi so a mu lege na zo ti tambula na gere na ando so ayeke naturel, mingi na akete lege ti tambula ni.

en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.
sg: Tambulango ti lango agongbi ayongo so ayo ti km oko asi na ayongo so ayeke yongoro mingi so zo a pe ti sara na lango oko.

en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.
sg: Ti tambula ti lango oko na lege so ayeke senge, akete lekengo ye ayeke da nda na zo kue tere ti lo yake nzoni ape ti sara kue.

en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.
sg: Asewa so ayeke na akete molenge a du a ti leke tere ti ala nzoni, me lango oko na gigi alingbi senga nga na abebe na akete molenge na ngu ti gue dambeti ti amolenge.

en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.
sg: Na niveau ti popokodoro, ayeke na akundu ti tambula 200 so alingbi ti sara kua.Mini na popo ti ala asara kua na ngangu ti ala mveni.

en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.
sg: Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours a za na sese réseau ti azo ti kusara ti Sightrunning balë ôko na osio acontinent kue.

en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.
sg: Na a racine na Running Tours Barcelona nga na Barcelone na Running Copenhagen ti si Copenhague, lo gongbi hio na Running Tours Prague so ayeke na Prague nga na mbeni ye.

en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.
sg: Ala du a ti hinga mbeni gbati aye kozo nga na la wa ala gue mbeni ndo.

en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.
sg: Tongana mo gue gene, ala hinga biani mbeni aye ayeke du legeoko na aye so mosara lakue lakue tongana mo "kiri yanga da". Adutingo, andia, kobe, tambula, da ti lango, andia, yanga nga na aye so a ga na peko ayeke duti nde na ndo so mo lango da.

en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.
sg: Ayeke mbe ye mo du a ti bata na bê ti mo, ti ke asara mo pasi wala sioni nzara ti sara aye ti kodoro pepe.

en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.
sg: Andokua ti aguengo gene a ba gigi londo ngûngbangbo 19. Zo ti kusara ndokua ti aguengo gene ayeke nzoni lege ti guengo gene ahon kozo hingango ti gne na gigi, mara ye nde nde, yanga wala akodoro ti kete nginza.

en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.
sg: Atâa mingi andokua ala yeda batango angende ti lakue lakue, gbati andokua ngba kusara gi na amara aguengo gene so ayeke nde, amama nginza wala ando ti gue da nde nde.

en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.
sg: Ayeke nzoni ti mu zo ti ndokua ti kusara so lo bata ngende ti mo lakue lakue.

en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.
sg: Ala za le ti ala na aguengo gene zo ti ndokua ti kusara lo fa ni, wala na site Web wala na ndo ti fango asango.

en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.
sg: Tonga mo ye ti ba dunia ti sigi gbati nzinza pepe, ti ba ye so ayeke nzoni, lege ba gigi wala tara ti sara mbeni ye, ambeni ayeke da ti sarango ya ni.

en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.
sg: Gündâ ahon kue, afa na alege use: wala sara aye ni ngoi so mo gue gene, wala tara ti sara si mo sigi gi kete nginza., Süra ni so afa ya ni kue.

en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.
sg: Ti azo so ape ti sigi gbtati nginza ndali ti duti nzoni, gbonga nga na ndara ti kiri sigi gi kete nginza a ga nduru na wâpi, ala ba ke mama nginza ti ala ti guengo gene.

en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.
sg: Awängö atene agene anzi pepe, asara sioni pepe, agongbi tere na gara ti ka mbeni ye Letâa a ke ndali ti ndia, ahunda mbeni ye pepe wala to asara kpale na azo ndali ti nzoni ti lo pepe.

en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.
sg: Andokua ni asara kusala na gbe bemben go ndo ti lindango ti a azo na kodoro wande ayeke kozo ndo ti lutingo na ngoi ti hurungo ti lapara, mangboko wala kutukutu nde.

en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.
sg: Na ya ti ambeni kutukutu ti wên ake gue nga na kodoro nde, aturugu a ba ambeti na ya ti kutukutu ti wên nga na ala du ati wara mbeti ti Letaa tongana mo gue na oko na popo ti akutukutu ti wên ni.

en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.
sg: Na akutukutu ti wên ti bi, zo ti yongo kutukutu ti wên a pe ti mu a passeport ndali ti buba lango ti mo pepe.

en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.
sg: Za sa iri ti mo ayeke hunda ti lege ti warango passeport.Na ambeni kodoro, ala du a ti fa iri ti mo na ndo so mo lango da na akota zo ti kodoro.

en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.
sg: A peti hunda ala ti su mbeni ye na forlulaire na turugu ti kodoro wala guengo na ndokua ti ba aey ti lindango na ya ti kodoro.

en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).
sg: Na yati agbati kodoro so ayeke na mara ndia so, ando ti lango ti kodoro ayeke mu iri ti mo (ala ke ti hunda pepe).

en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.
sg: Na bango ye so ayeke nde, gi alal so alango na gigi ti ndo ti lango ti a touriste adu a ti za iri ti ala za. Atâa, afa ndia atene tatene pepe, ni laa ala hunda azo kozo ni.

en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.
sg: Architecture aba lege ti lekengo ye nga la lekengo ti ada. Architechture ti mbeni ndo asara ti atouriste a za le ti ala nduru na ya ni.

en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.
sg: Agbati ada ayeke pendere ti bango ni nga na bango ni londo na kota da wala londo na fenetere so ayeke a luti na nzoni ndo ape ti ga pendere ye ti ba ni.

en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.
sg: Architecture agongbi ambeni ando ti kua tongana urbanisme, génie civil, arts décoratifs, architecture ti da nga na lekengo ndo ti yaka nga na ti anyama.

en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.
sg: Bango pueblo so ayo, ala pe ti wara pepender gigi na bî tongana ala gue na Albuquerque wala Santa Fe pepe.

en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).
sg: Andaa, agbati casino kue e za da iri ti ala na gbeni a ka asamba, nga na gbati na popo ti ala a mu mara ti angia na le ti azo (mingi akota zo so ayeke na Albuquerque wala Santa Fe).

en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.
sg: Sara ânge: ada ti yongo samba ti akete ngbata ayeke lakue lakue nzoni ndo ti agene pepe na gigi ti Letâa.

en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.
sg: Na mbange nde, banga ti Nouveau-Mexique ahinga ngangu kpalé ti yongo kutukutu nga na ti duti soule na samba nga na agongbi ti azo ti sulâre ayeke na nduzu nduru na ada ti kango samba ti akete gbata.

en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.
sg: Ambamba ti adere wala gribouillis so azo aye pepe a iri ala grafitis

en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.
sg: Atâa ayeke mbeni ye ti fini pepe, azo mingi agongbi na sarango sioni ti amaseka na ndo ti da ti Letâa nga na ti azo ti sarango mbamba na aérosol.

en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.
sg: Andâa, laso, azo ti sungo graffiti ahinga ala, amatanga ti graffiti nga na adere "Letâa ahinga". Ambamba ti graffiti na mara sarango ye ni so akpa amara ye nde nde nga na atene so azo ape ti ba pepe.

en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.
sg: Bïngö ti boomerang ayeke ndara so gbati atouriste aye ti wara ni.

en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.
sg: Tongana ala ye ti manda bi boomerang so akiri na maboko ti mo, mo du a ti hinga ti duti na boomerang so alingbi teti kiringo ti ye so mo bi nî.

en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy
sg: Gbati a boomerang ayeke na Australie ayeke na kiringo ni pepe. Ayeke nzoni na azo so ahinga kozo nzoni pepe ti ha ti bingo ti pupu.

en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.
sg: Kobe ti hangi aton na du ti wa nd ndo it sese.

en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.
sg: Du ni aza wa da nga na atene ti wa londo na wa, wala na ambeni ndo, ndo wa ti kodoro asara si wa aga na ando ti sese.

en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.
sg: Hangi asara ni ti ton mara ngbere kobe ti lakui so ayeke roti.

en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.
sg: Agbati ndo na Rotorua afa hangi so ayeke na ndowa ti kodoro, atâa ambeni hangi gue tara ala na Christchurch, Wellington nga na ndo nde.

en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).
sg: MetroRail ayke na angenge use na akutukutu tu wên ti akete kodoro nga na na gbata ti Cap:MetroPlus a iri Kozo Classe kue) nga na Metro (a iri Use Classe).

en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.
sg: MetroPlus ayeke na pendere dutingo ye nga na ayo azo mingi pepe me ngere ti lo ni ayeke ngangu kete, atâa ngere ni ayeke na sese ahon a ticket ti métro ti lakue lakue ti Poto.

en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.
sg: Kutukutu ti wên oko oko agongbi legeoko akutukutu ti MetroPlus nga na Metro; A autocar MetroPlus ayeke lakue lakue na gbe ti kutukutu wên so ayeke nduru na Cap.

en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.
sg: Yo ti azo nde - ala girisa ti za le na abozo ti ala pepe, mingi na ngoi ti fango a frontière ti apopokodoro.

en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.
sg: Ape ti sara si mo ga zo ti yongo bangi na peko ti mo, so ayeke ke mu kota kpalé na mo.

en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.
sg: Sarango ye ni so agongbi kungo ti gbati azo, ndali ti so ambo afu tere ti zo gingo manga ape ti sara kua tiala na ngbonga kue.

en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.
sg: Ambeni akodoro aza na ngbanga ti bango pasi so ayeke ngangu mingi, atâa na a kozo kete kete asioni, ape ti agongbi pasi ti gue dakanga ahon angu 10 wala kua.

en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.
sg: Abozo so azo aza le ti ala na ndoni pepe ayele mu lege na azo ti nzi nga na ape ti sara si akotazo ti kodoro aza le ti ala nduru na yani ndali ti kpengo kpélé ti bombe.

en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.
sg: Na yanga da, tere ti ala ayeke na gigi ti a kobela nde nde ti kodoro, ayeke nzoni mo bata tere ti mo ndali ti ala.

en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.
sg: me a ambeni ndo ti dunia, ndo so anyama ayeke na kobela so ayeke fini na mo, mo pe ti wara kpale mingi.

en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.
sg: Ahon ye kue, na yati sêndo so ndowa ayeke da mingi, a bactérie amai hio hio ngana aninga na gigi na ndo ti tere ti e.

en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.
sg: Ni lâa, akobele ti Delhi Belly, Sîonîbâ ti Pharaon, Revanche de Montezuma, nga na gbati amba ti ala.

en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.
sg: Tongana teti akpalé ti wu nzoni pepe na ndo ti sêndo ti de mingi, kpalé ti yâ na sêndo wa ayeke da mingi nga na a ye ni so ayeke zi siriri na tere ti mo me ayeke sioni mingi pepe.

en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.
sg: Tongana mo gue gne na kodoro so agba gi ti mai kozo ni - wala na mbeni mbage tu dunia - ala gbu li tiala na ndoti pasi ti mandango mbeni mara ye nde nde na dno so mo gue da.

en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.
sg: Agbati gene ti nginza nga na ti ndara li ti ala aga kiri kiri ndali ti fini ye ti guengo gene na ndoti akodoro ti maingo ni, dno so so mara ye nde nde ape ti gonbgi hio hio.

en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.
sg: Mingi na akozo lango ti ala, ala sara niga ti alal na ada ti lango, ti kobe nga na akusala ti poto so ayene nde nga napendere ti zi lege na mo si mo manda fini ye.

en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.
sg: Ala lango na matelat pepe wala na matelas so ayeke na sese na ando so ala hinga nzoni ndo ti anyama ti kodoro pepe.

en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.
sg: Tongana mo gue ti lango na gigi, ala gue na gbogbo ti gigi wala hamac ti kpe angbo , a scorpions nga na mbeni ye.

en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.
sg: Ala za da kâwa na ndaparere na da ti mo nga na dutë si asara tere ti ala nzoni ti camomille na lakui.

en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.
sg: Na ngoi ti hungo tere ti ala, ala yeke na tango ti sara ngia na ala mveni nga na mu angbonga mingi ahon ti ton mbeni aye ake nde.

en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:
sg: Tongana ala ye ti sara mbeni fini ye, ala sara jus ti ala wala agonbi a smoothies:

en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.
sg: ala pe ti wara mbeni samba so ayeke senge so mo pe ti leke ndali ti chaillé ti mo tongana mo kiri sara ye so mosara kozo lakue lakue.

en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.
sg: Tongana moyeke na kodoro so yongo samba ayeke nde, ala gue na da ti kango samba wala pubs ti avaka so ala kue da kozo pepe.

en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.
sg: Ti azo so ahinga atene ti seni pepe, atene infectueux nga na contagieux ayeke nde.

en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.
sg: Kobela ti infection ayeke kobela so agent pathogène a mu ni, tongana virus, bactérie, champignon wala a parasite a parasite nde nî.

en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.
sg: Kobela so ape ti mu zo nde ayeke kobela so zo ape ti mu senge dutingo nduru na zo so si wara kobela ni awe.

en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.
sg: Gbati agovoroma ahunda gene so a li kodoro wala azo ti kodoro so aye ti hon kodoro ala mu vaccin ndali ti kobela nde nde.

en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.
sg: Ahunda ni so ape ti duti nde nde na akodoro so gene ague da wala aye ti gue gene ni.

en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.
sg: Mbeni ye oko so ayeke ngangou na Charlotte, na Caroline ti tô, so lo bombi a nzoni aye ti ngangou teti a sewa.

en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.
sg: A la so a lango na mbeni a ndo a diko ka dutingo oko ti a sewa tongana mbeni kozo ndani ti tene a la duti, nga na aguene aba ti ala so kota gbata ayeke nzoni teti a molengue ti ala.

en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.
sg: Na ya ti a ngu bale use so ahon, hungo ti aye so a sara ngbanga ti a molengue na Uptown Charlotte a ma na nduzu ngangu mingi.

en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.
sg: A takassi so a sewa ti Charlotte a Sara na kusala pepe, a hon kue so a yeke nzoni teti a mbeni angoi.

en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.
sg: Ambeni aye na ndo ye ayeke da ti wara a hon a zo use, tongaso ye so a lingbi ti hon nguere ngangu.

en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.
sg: Antarctique a yeke ndo ti so de yeke mingui a hon ti a ndo ya ti dunia kue, na a nguru Pole ti tö.

en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.
sg: Güëngö gene ti a gene a yeke na ngere ngangu, na a hûnda nzoni saterê, na a ke wara legue gui na nze ti nabändurü ti si na folondïgi na a katikâti na kota mbâgë ti péninsule, na a zûâ na a ngu ingo ti Ross.

en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.
sg: A mbeni saki na ndo ni ti a zo ti sara ngo kua a duti ge na tango ti été na ya ti a gündâ osio a bale ûse, mbîrîmbîrî na ya ti a gbâködörö so; kette wu ngo ti ala a ngba na hiver.

en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.
sg: Antarctique ti ya ni a yeke mbeni kpângbârâ sembë so kandângû ti 2 - 3km a mu ndo ni kue.

en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.
sg: A tûru tî ndüzü so a gue na ya ti sesse, ti a alpinisme ou ti a wara Pôle, so a yeke na kota gündâ.

en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.
sg: South Pole Traverse (Highway) a yeke ndo ti kilometre 1600 ti station McMurdo na ndo ti ngu ingo Ross na pôle.

en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.
sg: Ayeke neige so a kpingba na a crevasses so a boumbi si a fa na a bendere. Alingbi ti hon da gui na a tracteur ni, gboto a kutukutu ti win na ngu ti dada nga na a nguki ti sara ngo na kua.

en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.
sg: Ala so a ne pepe, ndo kussala so a lingbi fade ti sara yongoro legue so a ba na tere ti hoto transantarctique ti si na ndo ti kete hoto.

en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.
sg: Ye so a sara si ndao a hu mingui na ngoy ti de a yeke glisser ngo ti legue, tere ti legue na mingui a tamboula.

en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.
sg: Ahon kue ala lingbi ti wara a poro so gbeni a lingbi na ni. A poro ti ndo wa ayeke glisser mingui na ndo ti glace nga na neige. A mbeni poro ti de a yeke nga ngangu pepe.

en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.
sg: Nda ti tene ni a lingbi ti duti a yo, penze ngbonga oku (ndambo li ti maboko na yongoro) wala ahon, nga a gbakuru ni so a ne pepe na ngoi ti de.

en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.
sg: Mbeni aporo ti de ayeke na acrampon nga na agbâkûrû so a za da ndali ti glissengo ye, ti mara ti amapapa kue nga na aporo ti de, ayeke na atalon wala mapapa ti atalon nga na asemelle.

en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.
sg: Amapapa ti talons a du ti duti na sese nga na akono. A mbutu, kete atene wala ingo (Chorure ti calcium) ala yeke mingi na yati lele wala alege na yati maingo a traction.

en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.
sg: Tingo ti hoto ayeke sioni pepe; ahoto so luti pepe a pe ti ninga gi kete, nga na hoto so ayeke na nduzu ayeke ti na lege ti tingo ti ambutu.

en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.
sg: Tene ayeke neige so si akanga tere na hoto, so a ye ti hunda si a ti tingo, nga na mbeni neige a ga ti a pe ti ga aye ni ake mu lege na aye kue ti titingo ni.

en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.
sg: Na mbeni tango, a yeni a sara si neinge a titingo ayeke ndo wa ti la a mu wa na neige, a pe ti mu lege kue neige so a ondoni ti titingo, a mbeni ye kue a ke baa gigi gi tongaso alondo na sarango ti azo a pe ti mu lege kue na ya ti titingo ti neige senge.

en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.
sg: Kota pupu ayeke a colonne ti air so ayeke na sese, so amu air ti ndo na yani nga na a gue na nduzu.

en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.
sg: Ayeke mu ngangu apupu(ayeke gue na loro 100 ti 200 mille na yati a ngbonga) nga na a pe ti yo kota akungba na ti gue na ni na nduzu, loyeke gue nani na lege so kota pupu ni a ke gue.

en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.
sg: Ayeke tondani ti kpa a entonnoir so ake londo na ambinda ti kota pupu nga na a ga "A Kota ngu nzampa" tongana a si na ndo ti sese.

en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.
sg: Azo ti kusara ti mungo VPN (réseau ti internet so ayeke privé) ayeke nzoni lege ti kpengo ti bi tene ti ala ti poroso nga na geofiltrage IP ti mosoro.

en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.
sg: Ahon ngangu ti proxys Web ndali ti gbati aye: Ala ke gue na tambula ti internet kue, ataa ye so ayeke gi http pepe.

en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.
sg: Ala yeke mu bande passante so ayeke na nduzu nga na nzoni mara ti kusara. Ala yeke crypté nga na ti tene ayeke ngangu na azo a pe ti sara copie ti lo pepe.

en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".
sg: Andokua ti vungango a sango atene vene mingi lakue lakue na ndo ti sango ni, ala tene ayeke gi lege ti "kengo a piratage".

en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.
sg: Ahon kue, acode ti gbata ala baa kpale oko pepe ndali ti copie so letaa ahinga pepe; a copie ti bit na ti bit ti disque ayeke tambula nzoni na a kusala kue ndo so si ala ke hunda kozo kusala ni.

en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.
sg: Ndani ti kozo tene ayeke ti mu lege na andokua ti kusara so ti zia le ti ala na ndoti agara ti ala; ye kue a bongbi tere na mosoro so a gue a kiri ni.

en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.
sg: Na lege so asara iringondo a gue na internet, mo pe ti sara na a ndokua ti singa pepe so ayeke na ndo so mo lango da wala ndo so mo yeke gue gene.

en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.
sg: Letaa ayeke hunda mo ti wara wungo ti singa ti kodoro na ndo so mo yeke lango da pepe; Mo pe ti wara connexion ti internet na lege ti sattelite na ndo ti bansenzi ti Chicken, Alaska nga na soro singa oko so atene mo yeke na ndo so ndowati Arizona a sara mingi.

en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.
sg: Mîngi nî, mo du a ti vo wungo ti singa na lge nde nde so ayeke mu lege na PSTN ti iri mo. Ndo so wungo ti singa a londo a fa yeni ayeke nde ndali ti azo so aye ti iri ala.

en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.
sg: A kusara ti kiri atene na yanga nde hio - akusara so a pe ti kiri gbati atene hio londo na mbeni yanga a si na yanga nde.

en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.
sg: Ambeni akusara ti a kundu so a pe ti kiri atene ti wande na a panneaux wala na ndo ti mbeni ye e pe ti su na yani na tango so zo so asara kua na singa ti smartphone na tangani akugba ni.

en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.
sg: Akusara ti gingo gingo na internet ti kiringo atene na yanga nde a mai mingi nga na a mu lakue lakue kiringo tene so ayeke tatene (a fa gi kete atene ti charabia), me azo a du ti sâra hânge, ala pe ti sigi atene so ake nzoni pepe.

en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.
sg: Oko na popo ti akusara so ahon ngangu kue ti kundu so ayeke Google Translate, so a mu lege na azo ti kiri atene na yanga nde gigi ti internet na peko ti telechargengo asango ti yanga so ala ye ni.

en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.
sg: Sarango na akusara ti internet GPS na singa ti smartphone ti mo a pe ti duti lege so ayeke senge nga na ayeke mu ngangu na kua ti gue na internet tongana mo yeke na kodoro wande.

en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.
sg: Lo pe ti bata mosoro na lege ti kengo ti vo a carte ti GPS, wala ti akusara ti GPS so asara lo oko wala louengo a carte na mbeni ndokua ti louengo a akutukutu.

en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.
sg: Tongana ala yeke na connexion internet na singa ti ala pepe, wala tongana ala yeke na ndo a yo mingi, ngangu ti kua ti lo a pe ti kanga wala ayeke sigi pepe.

en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.
sg: Da tî büzë oko oko ti ndo ni ayeke na gbati a mara ti carte ti singa ti prépayé so mo pe ti sara na dasinga ti azo kue wala senge asinga .

en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.
sg: Gbati acarte ayeke nzoni ti iri ndo kue, mbeni na popo ti ala ayeke sara kua ndali ti kete ngere ti iringondo so ague na mbeni kundu ti akodoro so ayeke nde.

en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.
sg: Warango akusara ni so ague na lege ti wungo ti singa so mo ke futa pepe mo yeke iri senge londo asinga kue.

en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.
sg: Andia ti mungo foto senge ague legeoko na ala so a baa batango a vidéo, ataa ahon ye kue.

en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.
sg: Ala ke ti mu lege na a mungo senge foto ti mbeni ye, ala pe ti nga gi ti bata a vidéo pepe.

en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.
sg: Tongana ala sara kua na yati drone, ala baa nzoni kozo ye so ala pe ti filmer nga na apermis ti nye wala alicence so Letaa a pe ti hunda ni.

en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.
sg: Tongana mo ye drone a huru na nduzu ti aéroport wala na nzudu ti kundu ti azo ayeke sioni tene, ataa letaa a mu lege ti sarango yeni pepe na gbata ti mo.

en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.
sg: Na yati lango so, mo pe ti gue gene na lapara pepe tongana mo bata ngende ti mo na lege ti a ndokua ti lapara nga na kozo ti gingo nga na baa nzoni ngere oko oko.

en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.
sg: Andaa, senge guengo gene a pe ti wara angere so ayeke nde mingi londo na andokua ti lapara nde nga na ayeke ngangu ti baa nzoni ngere oko oko nga na ti baa site web ti ndokua ti lapara ala-mveni kozo mo bata ngende ti mo ti lapara.

en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.
sg: Ataa mo ye ti wara visa pepe ti gue gene ti kete alango na mbeni kodoro wande na lege ti a tourist wala debuze, guengo ka tongana wamandango mbeti ti popokodoro ayeke hunda mingi dutingo so ayeke ninga na palaze ti gue ka gi tongana a touriste.

en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.
sg: Ahon ye kue, tongana mo ye ti ninga ti duti na kodoro wande mo yeke hunda ti wara kozo visa.

en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.
sg: Avisa ti wamandango mbeti ayeke na agbati hundango ye nga na alege nde ti hundango a visa ti touriste wala ti debuze so ayeke senge.

en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.
sg: Na aye so a baa kodoro kue, mo du a ti wara mbeti ti yedango ti dambeti mo ye ti gue manda mbeti, nga na mbeti ti fango mosoro mo yeke na ni ti futa aye kue na tango kue so mo yeke na kozo ngu ti mandango mbeti ti mo.

en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.
sg: Hunda ye kue na dambeti ti mo, nga na ndokua ti kusara ti immigration ti kodoro so mo ye ti gue manda mbeti ni ndali ti hinga biani ye so mo du a ti wara ni.

en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.
sg: Tongana mo yeke zo ti fango le ti kodoro pepe, nga na mo sara kua na kodoro wande mo du a ti faa mbeti ti kiri ti mo ndali ti nginza ti futa ti mo na kodoro so mo ye ke da.

en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.
sg: A kiri ti mo ndali ti nginza ti futa ti mo ayeke nde na a kodoro oko oko, nga na ngere ti sanzengo a nginza nga na tranches ti imposition ayeke gue nde na kodoro oko oko.

en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.
sg: Na mbeni akodoro so ayeke federal, tapande Etats-Unis nga na Canada, kiri ndali ti nginza ti futa a ke mu lege oko na mbage ti kodoro kue wala gbata ndo so mo yeke da, ayeke sara si sanzengo a nginza nga na tranches ti imposition a yeke duti nde na a gbata oko oko.

en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.
sg: Bembengo na ndo ti kusala ti lindango ti aye ayeke da pepe wala ayeke gi senge sarango ye tongana mo kiri kodoro, bembengo ti kusala ti kiri ayeke du kota kpale na mo.

en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.
sg: Ala sara ngangu ti hinga ye so mo ye ti hinga nga na ye so ala pe ti yo pepe nga na faa na le ti letaa aye kue.

en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.
sg: Lege so ayeke senge ti leke tere ti mo ti gue gene ayeke ti manda ye nzoni na internet so atene na ndo ti guengo gene.

en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.
sg: Na peko ti hingango ye ti formatage nga na su mbeni ye na lege ti internet, na peko ala pe ti za na sese site ti internet ti ala mveni.

en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.
sg: Sarango kua senge na ngoi ti guengo gene ayeke nzoni lege ti sara ye ayeke nde, me ayeke ti tene gi lege ti mungo ye pepe.

en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.
sg: Lango nga na sarango kua senge na kodoro wande ayeke nzoni lege ti baa fini teti akete mara nde, ti wara tere na fini azo, ti hinga tere, ti za na sese fini asarango ye nga na wara fini andara.

en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.
sg: A pe ti duti nzoni lege ti warango gbati nginza so ayeke mu lege na mo ti ninga na mbeni ndo, ndali ti agbati kua zo asara senge ayeke mu na ala ndo ti lango nga na batango tere nga na kete azo a futa gi kete nginza.

en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.
sg: Aviking ala gue na lege ti angu ti a Russe ti guengo na ngû îngö so a Vukö nga na ngû îngö ti Caspienne. Mbeni ambage ti alege so a pe ti ngba ti gue nani. Ala baa nzoni tongana ala yeke na mbeti ti mungo lege nde, so ayeke ngangu ti wara ni.

en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.
sg: Canal ti ngû îngö ti Blanche Baltique a kanga tere na ngû îngö ti Arctique na ngû îngö ti Baltique, na lege ti kötä ngû ti Onega, kötä ngû ti Ladoga nga na ti Saint-Pétersbourg, mingi na angû nga na akötä ngû.

en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.
sg: A kötä ngû ti Onega a kanga tere na Volga, mo pe ti londo na ngû îngö ti ti Caspienne na lege ti Russie.

en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.
sg: Ala hinga biani tongana ala si amarinas, ye kue ayeke du ti nzoni. La ke wara tere na azo nde so ala ke kanga lege na mangboko nga na yeke faa asango ti ala yamba na ala.

en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.
sg: Ti baa aye so ti gunda, ala ke faa tene ti mungo mbeni maboko ti mo, guengo na gigi ti a kutukutu tî wên, nudur na azo asukula yachts ti aka, hâa ti sara tene na aturugu ti ngu na da ti yongo a samba, na mbeni ye nde nde.

en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.
sg: Ala yeke hâa ti sara tene na gbati azo. N yati kete ngoi, azo kue ake hinga ala nga na ala ke tene na ala mangboko ti nye a ngba gi zo ti kua ni.

en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.
sg: Ala du a ti soro ndokua ti kusala ti lapara ti ala nzoni ndali ti so lo sara legeoko na mbeni ndokua ti kusara nde maboko na maboko.

en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.
sg: Ataa mo yeke baa mingi a ndokua ti kusara ti lapara so mo gue ka lakue lakue, ala du a ti hinga kusara so ala ke faa ayeke nde nde nga lege ti batango azo a pe ti duti nzoni na a ndokua ti kusala ti lapara so ayeke nde na ya saranga legeoko ti ala.

en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.
sg: Andokua ti kusala ti lapara tapande Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways nga na Turkish Airlines a gue na akusala tiala na mbage ti Afrika nga na a mu lege ti gue na gbati kota agbata ti Afrika na ngere so ayeke na sese bango a ngere so mbeni andokua ti kusala ti lapara ti poto ala faa.

en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.
sg: Turkish Airlines a gue na ando 39 destinations na akodoro ti Africa 30 na ngu 2014.

en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.
sg: Tongana guengo gene ti ala ayeke ninga, ala baa nzoni kota ngere ti ala kue to guengo na Afrika ayeke bango ngere oko ti guengo na dunia kue.

en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.
sg: Ala girisa pepe ti za da ngere ti avisa, akiri ti londo na mbeni ndo, ngere ti a kutukutu, na mbeni ye ti ando so kue na gigi ti Afrika.

en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.
sg: Tongana mo yeti gue na yati dunia kue na hémisphère ti bongo, sorongo a guengo gene nga na ando ti guengo ni ayeke gi kete ndali ti alege ti transocéanique a da pepe.

en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).
sg: Yanga daa oko ti guengo na lapara a pe ti mu alege ota ti ngû îngö na a hémisphère ti bongo (nga na SjyTeam a gue na alege so pepe).

en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.
sg: Ataa, Star Alliance a a gue ando kue zia tô ti Pacifique ti bongo ti Santiago ti Chili a si na Tahiti, so ayele lapara ti LATAM Oneworld.

en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)
sg: Tambula so ayeke gi lege oko so mo peti mu pepe tongana mo ke ti gue na lege ti Pacifique ti Mbongo nga na cote ouest ti Amerika ti Mbongo. (Baa yani na sese )

en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.
sg: Na yati ngu 1994, gbata so ayeke na bgati azo ti arménie ti Haut-Karabakh na kodoro ti Azerbaïdjan a tiri bira na azo to kodoro sese ti Azéris

en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.
sg: Na mungo maboko ti azo ti Arménie, fini kodoro a baa gigi. Kandaa, Kodoro oko pepe, nga na Arménie kue, ahinga lo na lege ni pepe.

en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.
sg: Adekite ti kota azo ti kodoro na ndo ti sese a ngba bata mango tere na popo ti a kodoro ti Arménie nga na kodoro ti Azerbaïdjan.

en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.
sg: A vaka ti canal (a iri na yanga ti néerlandais: Grachtengordel) ayeke vaka azo mingi a hinga ti ngûngbangbo ti 17 a mu ndo ti Binnenstad ti Amsterdam.

en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.
sg: Ala za gbata kue na popo ti kungba ti dunia kue ti UNESCO ndali ti hingango ti ndara nga na ti hingango ndo ti lo, nga na hingango ti akungba ti lo ayeke na nduzu ahon ti akungbga ti kodoro mingi.

en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.
sg: Cinque Terre, atene Sese Oku ayeke na kete agbata oku so ayeke na mbage ti ngu ti Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza nga na Monterosso ayeke na ndo ti Ligurie na kodoro ti Italie.

en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
sg: Ala za iri ti ala na popo ti kungba ti dunia kue ti UNESCO.

en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.
sg: Na peko ti angûngbangbo, azo a leke apalaze ti yongo wala tengo ye na ya ti ndo so aye na hoto nga na kota atene so a gue ti li nda na yati kötä ngû îngö.

en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.
sg: Ndambo nzoni ye ti lo ayeke maingo ti ndokua ti lo so ayeke na le ti zo pepe. Alege, akutukutu tî wên nga na amangboko a mu agbata, nga akutukutu a pe ti li da yati agbata pepe.

en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.
sg: Mara ti yanga ti falanzi so atene na kodoro ti Belgique nga na Suisse ayeke nde kete na yanga ti falanzi atene na kodoro ti France, ataa ayanga ni akpa mingi na lege ti ndara.

en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.
sg: Mingi a kusara ti mungo wungo na Belgique ti falanzi nga na ti Suisse ayeke kete nde na yanga ti falanzi so atene na France, nga na lege ti sarango tene ti mbeni atene ayeke kete nde.

en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.
sg: Atâa, azo ti Belgique nga na ti Suisse ti falanzi kue amanda yanga ti falanzi na dambeti, ayeke na ndara ti ma ala atâa ala sara na lege ti wungo ti falanzi azo kue ahinga.

en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."
sg: Na gbati ando ti dunia kue, bara azo na maboko afa sarango ye na mba ti mo atene "bara ala".

en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.
sg: Kandaa, na Malaisie, na yati kete agbata a yo, yeni atene "mo ga", akpa use kete maboko so si a baa tere, sarango ye so azo ti kodoro ti poto asara ka ni mingi, nga na a pe ti fa gi yeni tanso pepe.

en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.
sg: Na eye ni so, zo to tambela ti kodoro ti Grande Bretagne na sese ti Espagne lo pe ti hinga nzoni pepe lege ti tene gue nzoni na maboko ti lo (na palaze ti zo so mo ye ti sara tene na lo) ti fa sarango ye ti kiringo ni.

en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.
sg: Ayanga so a mu lege na mbeni yanga ti ba gigi ayeke yanga a iri artificiel wala azo a leke ni ndali ti mu maboko na azo ti sara tene na mba ti ala na ngangu pepe tongaso pepe sarango tene na popo ti azo a du a ti duti ngangu mingi.

en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.
sg: Ayanga ni ayeke nde na lingua francas, so ayeke a ba gigi gi tanso na ga yanga azo aten mingi ndani so e hinga wala e hinga pepe me a gi na lege ti sara tene na popo ti azo ti ayanga ti kodoro nde.

en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).
sg: Na yati wa ti lango oko, azo ti gue gene ala pe ti ba mirage so a fa yeso akpa ngu (wala mbeni ye).

en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.
sg: Mirage ni so a pe ti ga sioni tongana zo ti gue gene a mu loro na mirage ni, lo yeke buba pendere wa nga na tangani ngu so angba.

en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.
sg: Atâa yândo so ayeke na ndo wa mingi a pe ti pe ti kiri ndo ti de mingi na lakui. Tere ti zo a pe ti kiri na sese ti 35°C tongana lo yo bongo ti wa pepe.

en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.
sg: Na ngoi ti été, mingi, ala du a ti sâra hânge na angoungou ye ti li nda na gbako so si ndo wa ayeke ngangu mingi.

en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.
sg: Atâa ala gue na kutukutu na gbako so si ndo wa ayeke ngangu mingi, kete ngbonga so ala ke zi ayanga ti kutukutu ti ala alingbi na angoungou ti li da mo biani.

en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.
sg: Grippe ti kondon, wala a irir mingi grippe ti kondon, a pe ti wara a ndeke nga na anyama.

en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.
sg: A faa sango ti a kete ahon sâke ôko ti azo , me mingi na popo ti ala ala kui.

en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.
sg: Aye so abaa mingi gbati azo so asara mbeni ye na sese, me mbe kpale ayeke da na bango andeke.

en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.
sg: Afjord ayeke na mara ti atene so a pe ti kanga lege ti gue na yati ngu nga na ahoto so ayeke mu lege hio na a mara ti sese nga na ti hoto so a yo na a kono wala ayeke kete a ngba mining na kodoro ti Norvège.

en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.
sg: A iri plateaux so "vidde", atene ndo so akono nga na a zi ayeke na keke pepe, ndo ni akono mingi.

en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.
sg: Na Rogaland nga na Agder, a iri ala mingi "hei", atene lande so ayeke na keke pepe ayeke na bruyère.

en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.
sg: Kota a glace ti neige angba gi a kpingba pepe, me ayeke zuu londo ka na hoto. Ayeke zi lege, adu so ayeke fa mara ti gbagbara ti neige ni.

en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.
sg: Aderê nga na li ti kota du ti tene ti glace a pe ti fa nga na afango ni a pe ti kanga kue.

en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.
sg: Na yanga ti akota glace, kota a tene ti glace ayeke londo ka, ayeke ti nga na ayeke huru wara ayeke lurêe a yo mingi na yanga ni.

en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.
sg: Ngoi ti atouriste ando ti hoto aga na nduzu mingi na tango ti ngoi ti ndowa ti azo ti Inde.

en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.
sg: Kandâa, ala yeke pendere nga na nzoni ye so ayeke nde na ngoi so de asara mingi, na a gbati ndo ti sarango ski ti hoto awara nzoni kota neige nga na amu lege na azo ti sara ngia na ski nga na snowboard.

en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.
sg: Gi a kete ndokua ti kusara ti lapara a fa ngere tongana ala yeke na müä, ayeke kiri ngere na sese ti tambela ti müä so asi hio.

en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.
sg: Andokua ti kusara ti lapara so a mu kua so ayeke Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa so abaa tambela so alondo na Etats Unis wala Canada nga na WesJet.

en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
sg: Ahon kue, ala du a ti bata ngende ti ala na lege ti singa na ndokua ti kusara ti lapara biani.
